title.en: Yelu Abaoji becomes Yilijin of the Diela tribe of the Khitans

summary.en: Yelu Abaoji, chief of the Diela tribe of the Khitans, was elected as their Yilijin (military leader) for his bravery and skill in battle. He then led campaigns against neighboring tribes such as the Shiwei and Wugu, capturing many people and livestock, thus laying a military foundation for the rise of the Khitans. Over the next decade, Abaoji gradually unified the eight Khitan

statement.zh: 契丹迭剌部首领耶律阿保机因骁勇善战，被推选为本部的夷离堇（军事首领）。
statement.en: Yelu Abaoji, chief of the Diela tribe of the Khitans, was elected as their Yilijin (military leader) for his bravery and skill in battle.

zh: 契丹迭剌部首领耶律阿保机因骁勇善战，被推选为本部的夷离堇（军事首领）。
en: Yelu Abaoji, chief of the Diela tribe of the Khitans, was elected as their Yilijin (military leader) for his bravery and skill in battle.

statement.zh: 他随后率军征讨邻近的室韦、乌古等部落，俘获大量人口和牲畜，初步奠定了契丹崛起的军事基础。
statement.en: He then led campaigns against neighboring tribes such as the Shiwei and Wugu, capturing many people and livestock, thus laying a military foundation for the rise of the Khitans.

zh: 他随后率军征讨邻近的室韦、乌古等部落，俘获大量人口和牲畜，初步奠定了契丹崛起的军事基础。
en: He then led campaigns against neighboring tribes such as the Shiwei and Wugu, capturing many people and livestock, thus laying a military foundation for the rise of the Khitans.

note.zh: 批量上下文重写；事实待来源核验

statement.zh: 此后十多年间，阿保机逐步统一契丹八部，并于916年正式称帝建立辽朝。
statement.en: Over the next decade, Abaoji gradually unified the eight Khitan tribes, and in 916 formally proclaimed himself emperor, establishing the Liao dynasty.

zh: 此后十多年间，阿保机逐步统一契丹八部，并于916年正式称帝建立辽朝。
en: Over the next decade, Abaoji gradually unified the eight Khitan tribes, and in 916 formally proclaimed himself emperor, establishing the Liao dynasty.

title.en: Zhu Wen seizes control of the court, Emperor Zhaozong becomes a puppet

summary.en: Tang jiedushi (military governor) Zhu Wen (Zhu Quanzhong) gradually gained control over the Central Plains after suppressing the Huang Chao Rebellion. In 901, Zhu Wen led his army into Chang'an, killed the eunuchs, and took Emperor Zhaozong hostage, forcing him to move the capital to Luoyang. The emperor became a puppet, and the central authority of the Tang dynasty existed in

statement.zh: 唐末节度使朱温（朱全忠）在平定黄巢起义后逐渐掌握中原实权。
statement.en: Tang jiedushi (military governor) Zhu Wen (Zhu Quanzhong) gradually gained control over the Central Plains after suppressing the Huang Chao Rebellion.

zh: 唐末节度使朱温（朱全忠）在平定黄巢起义后逐渐掌握中原实权。
en: Tang jiedushi (military governor) Zhu Wen (Zhu Quanzhong) gradually gained control over the Central Plains after suppressing the Huang Chao Rebellion.

statement.en: In 901, Zhu Wen led his army into Chang'an, killed the eunuchs, and took Emperor Zhaozong hostage, forcing him to move the capital to Luoyang.

zh: 901年，朱温率军进入长安，诛杀宦官，控制唐昭宗，迫使皇帝迁都洛阳。
en: In 901, Zhu Wen led his army into Chang'an, killed the eunuchs, and took Emperor Zhaozong hostage, forcing him to move the capital to Luoyang.

zh: 昭宗从此成为傀儡，唐朝中央权威名存实亡。

title.en: First stone castles emerge in Western Europe

summary.en: To defend against incursions by Magyars, Vikings, and Muslims, lords across Western Europe began converting wooden fortifications into stone castles. The Langeais Castle in the Loire Valley of France and Meersburg Castle in Germany are representative of this period. Stone walls could be up to three meters thick, complemented by towers and moats, greatly enhancing defensive capa

title.en: The Maya city-state of Chichen Itza reaches its zenith

summary.en: The Maya city-state of Chichen Itza in the northern Yucatán Peninsula entered a flourishing period under the influence of Toltec culture. Its rulers began constructing large structures such as the Kukulcán Pyramid (El Castillo), blending Maya astronomical calendars with Toltec military traditions. Chichen Itza gradually became the political and religious center of Postclassic M

statement.zh: 尤卡坦半岛北部的玛雅城邦奇琴伊察在托尔特克文化影响下进入繁盛阶段。
statement.en: The Maya city-state of Chichen Itza in the northern Yucatán Peninsula entered a flourishing period under the influence of Toltec culture.

zh: 尤卡坦半岛北部的玛雅城邦奇琴伊察在托尔特克文化影响下进入繁盛阶段。
en: The Maya city-state of Chichen Itza in the northern Yucatán Peninsula entered a flourishing period under the influence of Toltec culture.

statement.zh: 统治者开始修建库库尔坎金字塔（羽蛇神金字塔）等大型建筑，融合玛雅天文历法与托尔特克军事传统。
statement.en: Its rulers began constructing large structures such as the Kukulcán Pyramid (El Castillo), blending Maya astronomical calendars with Toltec military traditions.

zh: 统治者开始修建库库尔坎金字塔（羽蛇神金字塔）等大型建筑，融合玛雅天文历法与托尔特克军事传统。

statement.en: Chichen Itza gradually became the political and religious center of Postclassic Maya civilization, controlling trade networks across the northern peninsula.

title.en: Gung Ye founds Later Goguryeo, opening the Later Three Kingdoms era

summary.en: Gung Ye, a discarded scion of the Silla royal house who had been raised as a monk, first served the warlord Gi Hwon at Jukju, then Yang Gil at Bugwon, gradually absorbing their followings. In 901 he proclaimed himself king at Songak under the name Later Goguryeo, rallying support with the promise of avenging the fallen northern kingdom; in 904 he renamed the state Majin with th

statement.zh: 弓裔出身新罗王室而遭遗弃，早年为僧，后投竹州箕萱、转依北原梁吉，渐次兼并其众。
statement.en: Gung Ye, a discarded scion of the Silla royal house who had been raised as a monk, first served the warlord Gi Hwon at Jukju, then Yang Gil at Bugwon, gradually absorbing their followings.

zh: 弓裔出身新罗王室而遭遗弃，早年为僧，后投竹州箕萱、转依北原梁吉，渐次兼并其众。
en: Gung Ye, a discarded scion of the Silla royal house who had been raised as a monk, first served the warlord Gi Hwon at Jukju, then Yang Gil at Bugwon, gradually absorbing their followings.

note.zh: 批量上下文重写；事实待来源核验

statement.zh: 901年据松岳自立为王，国号"后高句丽"，以复高句丽之仇号召人心；904年改国号摩震、建元武泰，911年再改称泰封，迁都铁原。
statement.en: In 901 he proclaimed himself king at Songak under the name Later Goguryeo, rallying support with the promise of avenging the fallen northern kingdom; in 904 he renamed the state Majin with the era name Mutae, and in 911 renamed it again as Taebong, moving his capital to Cheorwon.

zh: 901年据松岳自立为王，国号"后高句丽"，以复高句丽之仇号召人心；904年改国号摩震、建元武泰，911年再改称泰封，迁都铁原。
en: In 901 he proclaimed himself king at Songak under the name Later Goguryeo, rallying support with the promise of avenging the fallen northern kingdom; in 904 he renamed the state Majin with the era name Mutae, and in 911 renamed it again as Taebong, moving his capital to Cheorwon.

note.zh: 批量上下文重写；事实待来源核验

statement.zh: 此前892年甄萱已在完山州建后百济，新罗、后百济、后高句丽三分半岛，史称后三国。
statement.en: Gyeon Hwon had already founded Later Baekje at Wansanju in 892, so the peninsula was now divided three ways among Silla, Later Baekje and Later Goguryeo — the Later Three Kingdoms.

zh: 此前892年甄萱已在完山州建后百济，新罗、后百济、后高句丽三分半岛，史称后三国。
en: Gyeon Hwon had already founded Later Baekje at Wansanju in 892, so the peninsula was now divided three ways among Silla, Later Baekje and Later Goguryeo — the Later Three Kingdoms.

note.zh: 批量上下文重写；事实待来源核验

statement.zh: 弓裔晚年自称弥勒佛化身，妄言观心之术、诛戮无度，918年为部将王建取而代之。
statement.en: In his last years Gung Ye declared himself an incarnation of the Maitreya Buddha, claimed the power to read minds and killed without restraint, and in 918 he was overthrown by his own general Wang Geon.

zh: 弓裔晚年自称弥勒佛化身，妄言观心之术、诛戮无度，918年为部将王建取而代之。
en: In his last years Gung Ye declared himself an incarnation of the Maitreya Buddha, claimed the power to read minds and killed without restraint, and in 918 he was overthrown by his own general Wang Geon.

note.zh: 批量上下文重写；事实待来源核验

statement.zh: 901年弓裔在松岳自立为后高句丽王；他与892年建立后百济的甄萱及新罗并立，史称后三国。
statement.en: In 901 Gung Ye proclaimed himself king at Songak as Later Goguryeo; with Gyeon Hwon's Later Baekje (892) and Silla, the peninsula became the Later Three Kingdoms.

sources.excerpt: Largely as a result of these trends, two provincial leaders, Gyeon Hwon and Gung Ye, established, respectively, the Later Baekje (892) and Later Goguryeo (also called Majin or Taebong; 901) kingdoms. Together with Silla, they are commonly referred to as the Later Three Kingdoms.

zh: 901年据松岳自立为王
en: In 901 he proclaimed himself king at Songak under the name Later Goguryeo

note.zh: 来源记甄萱892年建后百济、弓裔901年建后高句丽（又称摩震、泰封），与新罗合称后三国；正文所记弓裔出身、904年改号摩震、911年改泰封、迁都铁原、自称弥勒与918年被王建取代等细节来源未在同段支持，claim 不写。
note.en: The source records Gyeon Hwon's Later Baekje (892) and Gung Ye's Later Goguryeo (also Majin or Taebong; 901), which together with Silla formed the Later Three Kingdoms; it does not in the same passage support the body's details about Gung Ye's origins, the 904 and 911 renamings, move to Cheorwon, Maitreya claim, or 918 overthrow, so the claim omits them.

title.en: Zhu Wen massacres all eunuchs, ending eunuch domination of the Tang court

summary.en: After taking control of Emperor Zhaozong, Zhu Wen ordered a massacre of all eunuchs. All but thirty young ones left for menial tasks were beheaded in Luoyang, ending more than 150 years of eunuch domination at the Tang court. However, Zhu Wen's motive was not loyalty to the dynasty but to clear obstacles to his own usurpation.

title.en: Zhu Wen murders Emperor Zhaozong, enthrones Emperor Ai

summary.en: Zhu Wen forced Emperor Zhaozong to move the capital from Chang'an to Luoyang, then had his agent Jiang Xuanhui and others murder the emperor while he was drunk. title.en: Christianity formally introduced to Northern Europe

summary.en: King Harald Bluetooth of Denmark erected the famous Jelling Rune Stone in Jutland, inscribed with the words: "King Harald made the Danes Christian." He forced the nobility to accept baptism and built the first wooden church of the Viking Age. Norway and Sweden subsequently converted as well. Northern Europe thus left its native beliefs and joined Latin Christendom.

title.en: Persian philosopher al-Farabi completes his commentary on Aristotle

summary.en: Al-Farabi, born in Central Asia, completed his work "The Philosophy of Aristotle" in Baghdad, systematically commenting on Aristotle's logic, metaphysics, and ethics. He also proposed a model for an ideal city, deeply influenced by Plato's Republic. Al-Farabi is known as the "Second Teacher" (the first being Aristotle) in the Islamic world.

title.en: Li Keyong dies; Li Cunxu succeeds as Prince of Jin

statement.zh: 晋王李克用病死于太原，其子李存勖继位，年仅23岁。李克用临终前交给李存勖三支箭，分别代表与后梁朱温、河北刘仁恭和契丹耶律阿保机的仇恨。李存勖将箭供奉在家庙，每战取一支出征，激励三军。他后来成为后梁的终结者，建立后唐。
statement.en:
Li Keyong, Prince of Jin, died of illness in Taiyuan and was succeeded by his son Li Cunxu, only 23 years old. On his deathbed, Li Keyong gave his son three arrows, representing his enmity with Zhu Wen of Later Liang, Liu Rengong of Hebei, and Yelu Abaoji of the Khitans. Li Cunxu enshrined the arrows in his ancestral temple, taking one with each campaign to inspire his troops. He later destroyed Later Liang and founded the Later Tang dynasty.

For Asia in 908 CE, “Li Keyong dies; Li Cunxu succeeds as Prince of Jin” is a traceable node of Politics change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.en: Later Liang casts Kaiping Tongbao coins

summary.en: Emperor Taizu of Later Liang ordered the minting of "Kaiping Tongbao" copper coins, the first official currency of the Five Dynasties period. However, copper resources were scarce, so few were minted, and the populace continued to use old Tang coins and cloth as mediums of exchange.

statement.zh:
后梁太祖朱温下令铸造“开平通宝”铜钱，是五代时期第一种官方货币。但后梁铜资源匮乏，铸量很少，民间仍主要使用唐朝旧钱和布帛交易。新钱象征正统与改元，实际流通却有限；币材短缺使布帛与旧钱继续充当媒介。政权以铸币宣示合法性。

把「北宋（后梁）铸开平通宝」放回公元911年的后梁，可以看到经济变化的一个具体切面。

title.en: Oleg of Kievan Rus' dies; Igor succeeds

summary.en: In 912, Oleg, Grand Prince of Kiev, died and his kinsman Igor succeeded, continuing the Rurikid line.

statement.zh:
912年，基辅罗斯大公奥列格去世，亲属伊戈尔继位，留里克王朝延续统治。奥列格是王朝早期的重要统治者，他的去世没有造成王朝中断，权力在留里克家族内部完成交接。伊戈尔继位后继续以基辅为中心经营罗斯的商路与附庸关系，王朝的统治框架得以保持。

title.en: Ki no Tsurayuki writes the Tosa Diary

summary.en: The Japanese noble Ki no Tsurayuki, after completing his term as governor of Tosa Province (present-day Kōchi Prefecture) and on his way back to Kyoto, wrote a diary in the voice of a woman, describing his journey and the grief of losing his daughter. This is the first diary work in Japanese literature and inaugurated the tradition of kana literature.

statement.zh: 日本贵族纪贯之在从土佐国（今高知县）任满返回京都途中，以女性口吻撰写日记，描写旅途见闻和丧女之痛。这是日这一事件学史上第一部日记文学作品，开创了假名文学的先河。行旅的舟行、驿站与天气写入日常，私人的哀伤与观察交织；假名的书写使和文的表现力得以舒展。

title.en: Henry the Fowler is crowned Duke of Saxony

summary.en: After the death of Louis the Child, king of East Francia, the Saxon duke Henry the Fowler was elected king by the nobles (though he would not be formally crowned until 919). Henry began reorganizing the German army, training heavy cavalry to fight the Magyars, and building castles along the frontier. He was the father of Otto the Great, founder of the Holy Roman Empire.

title.en: Fatimids capture Alexandria

summary.en: The Fatimid navy sailed from al-Mahdiyya and took advantage of internal strife among the Abbasid governor of Egypt to capture Alexandria, the Mediterranean gateway to Egypt. This gave the Fatimids a beachhead in Egypt, but the real conquest of the country would not occur until 969. This occupation lasted only a few months before Abbasid forces retook the city.

title.en: Zhu Youzhen kills his brother and seizes the throne; civil war in Later Liang

summary.en: After Zhu Yougui had murdered his father and proclaimed himself emperor, his brother Zhu Youzhen conspired with imperial guard officers to attack the palace in Luoyang and kill Zhu Yougui. Zhu Youzhen then succeeded him, becoming the last emperor of Later Liang. The two successive coups greatly weakened Later Liang, giving an opportunity to Li Cunxu, the Prince of Jin.

title.en: Nanzhao falls; precursor of the Dali Kingdom emerges

summary.en: Zheng Maisi, a powerful minister in Nanzhao, staged a coup, killing the last Nanzhao king, Shunhuazhen, and more than eight hundred members of the royal family, ending the Nanzhao kingdom. Zheng Maisi established the Great Changhe Kingdom, but internal contradictions were severe. More than thirty years later, Duan Siping would replace it and found the Dali Kingdom.

title.en: Tsar Simeon I of Bulgaria captures Adrianople

summary.en: Taking advantage of a Byzantine civil war, Tsar Simeon I of the First Bulgarian Empire led his army south, besieging and capturing the important Thracian city of Adrianople (modern Edirne). He captured the Byzantine governor of the city and forced the Byzantine regent, Empress Zoe, to recognize Bulgarian sovereignty over northern parts of the Balkans.

title.en: Later Liang's last emperor Zhu Youzhen kills the powerful minister Li Zhen

summary.en: To purge his former allies in the coup that killed his brother, Emperor Modi of Later Liang executed the chancellor Li Zhen on charges of "abusing power and creating chaos." He also demoted a number of old officials and appointed literati such as Jing Xiang and Li Qi to high office. However, Modi was suspicious and jealous, exacerbating internal disunity.

title.en: Compilation of the Engi Shiki completed in Japan

summary.en: Emperor Daigo of Japan ordered the completion of the Engi Shiki in fifty volumes, a systematic compilation of statutes, regulations, official ranks, rituals, taxes, and other systems. This work became the standard for court administration in the mid-Heian period and had a lasting impact.

statement.zh: 日本醍醐天皇下令编纂完成《延喜式》五十卷，系统整理律令条文、官制、祭祀、租税等制度。该书成为平安时代中后期朝廷行政的准则，对后世影响深远。式目把政令细则与仪式程序分类汇编，供官员按条执行；朝廷借此整顿地方行政与财政，律令体制的日常运作由此定型。

title.en: Former Shu and Southern Han establish friendly relations to resist Later Liang

summary.en: Wang Jian, emperor of Former Shu, and Liu Yan, ruler of Southern Han, formed an alliance to jointly resist the edicts of Later Liang. title.en: Worship of Odin continues in Iceland

summary.en: Most of Iceland's inhabitants were immigrants fleeing the oppression of Harald Fairhair of Norway. They still worshiped the Norse gods Odin (Wodan), Thor, and others. Annual sacrifices were held, and the law assembly, the Thing, was held in front of a temple. The Christian church had not yet been established in Iceland.

statement.zh: 李存勖攻克后梁的魏州（今河北大名），俘获梁将刘鄩，魏博镇降晋。魏博是天雄军节度使驻地，拥有精锐的“银枪效节军”，李存勖收编这支军队后实力大增，奠定了灭梁的基础。
statement.en:
Li Cunxu captured Weizhou (present-day Daming, Hebei) from Later Liang, taking the Liang general Liu Xun prisoner. The Weibo circuit surrendered to the Jin. Weizhou was the seat of the Tianxiong Army, which possessed an elite corps known as the "Silver Spear and Halberd Army." Li Cunxu incorporated this unit into his forces, greatly strengthening his military power and laying the foundation for his eventual destruction of Liang.

For Asia in 916 CE, “Li Cunxu captures Weizhou” is a traceable node of Military change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.en: The Lighthouse of Alexandria collapses in an earthquake

summary.en: A powerful earthquake struck the Mediterranean coast, causing the upper structure of the Lighthouse of Alexandria (one of the Seven Wonders of the Ancient World) to collapse. The lighthouse gradually fell into ruin, and in 1480 the sultan used its stone to build a fortress.

statement.zh: 地中海沿岸发生强烈地震，建于公元前3世纪的亚历山大灯塔（世界七大奇迹之一）上层结构坍塌。此后灯塔逐渐废弃，1480年苏丹用其石料修建亚历山大城堡。塔身以阶梯与螺旋通道上升，顶端燃火反光以指引航船；地震与海侵不断侵蚀基座，昔日的地标终成堡垒的一部分。
statement.en: A powerful earthquake struck the Mediterranean coast, and the upper structure of the Lighthouse of Alexandria, one of the Seven Wonders and built in the third century BC, collapsed.

summary.en: Yelu Abaoji formally proclaimed himself emperor at Longhua Prefecture (modern Naiman Banner, Inner Mongolia), taking the dynastic name of "Khitan" (later changed to "Liao"), and styled himself the Great Sage Great Bright Heavenly Emperor, with the reign name Shence. He established a bureaucracy modeled on Chinese systems and created the Khitan large script and the Khitan small

statement.zh: 耶律阿保机在龙化州（今内蒙古奈曼旗）正式称帝，建国号“契丹”（后改“辽”），自称大圣大明天皇帝，年号神册。
statement.en: Yelu Abaoji formally proclaimed himself emperor at Longhua Prefecture (modern Naiman Banner, Inner Mongolia), taking the dynastic name of "Khitan" (later changed to "Liao"), and styled himself the Great Sage Great Bright Heavenly Emperor, with the reign name Shence.

sources.excerpt: Elected to a three-year term as great khan of the Khitans, Abaoji refused to resign at the end of his term but made himself king of the Khitan nation. After the collapse in 907 of Tang rule in China, Abaoji made himself emperor and by 916 had set up a Chinese-style dynasty, with his son as heir apparent. He organized his followers into fighting units known as ordos and then joined 12 ordos into an administrative district.

title.en: Kingdom of Burgundy splits into Upper and Lower Burgundy

summary.en: After the death of King Rudolf II of Burgundy, the kingdom was divided into Upper Burgundy (around Arles) and Lower Burgundy (Provence). The two were absorbed into the spheres of influence of the Holy Roman Empire and West Francia respectively, and Burgundy would never be reunited.

statement.zh: 勃艮第国王鲁道夫二世去世后，王国分裂为上勃艮第（阿尔勒地区）和下勃艮第（普罗旺斯地区）。两国分别被并入神圣罗马帝国和西法兰克王国的影响范围，勃艮第从此不再统一。
statement.en: After the death of King Rudolf II of Burgundy, the kingdom was divided into Upper Burgundy (around Arles) and Lower Burgundy (Provence).

title.en: The Tafsir al-Tabari, a commentary on the Qur'an, is completed

summary.en: The Persian scholar Muhammad ibn Jarir al-Tabari completed his thirty-volume comprehensive commentary on the Qur'an, known as the Tafsir al-Tabari. It gathered earlier hadiths and scholarly interpretations of the Qur'anic verses and is one of the most authoritative Sunni tafsirs.

statement.zh:
波斯学者穆罕默德·伊本·贾里尔·塔巴里完成了三十卷的《古兰经经注大全》（塔巴里经注），汇集前代圣训和学者对经文的解释，是逊尼派最权威的古兰经注之一。他按经文次序逐段征引异文与传说，兼录语法与律法意见；注释的体例为后世经注所沿袭。

把「《古兰经》经注《塔巴里经注》完稿」放回公元918年的波斯，可以看到宗教变化的一个具体切面。
statement.en: The Persian scholar Muhammad ibn Jalil Tabari completed the thirty-volume "Commentary on the Qur'an" (Tabari Commentary), which collects the hadiths and scholars' interpretations of the scriptures from previous generations.

title.en: Yang Longyan proclaims himself King of Wu, formally establishing the Wu Kingdom

summary.en: Yang Longyan, jiedushi of Huainan, under pressure from his officials, proclaimed himself King of Wu, changing the reign title to Wuyi and making Jiangdu (Yangzhou) his capital. title.en: Japan compiles the Engi Shinsen

statement.en: In 919, in the year after his accession Wang Geon moved the court from Cheorwon, Gung Ye's capital, back to his home town of Songak, renamed it Gaeju and made it his capital — the city later known as Kaegyeong (modern Kaesong).

statement.en: He divided it into five wards, raised palaces and walls, and founded ten temples within it, among them Beopwangsa and Wangryunsa, so that the Buddhist law would guard the new capital.

statement.en: Backed by Mount Songak to the north and facing the Yeseong river to the south, with its outport of Byeongnando opening onto the Yellow Sea, Kaegyeong commanded the land and water routes of the central peninsula.

title.en: Henry I is crowned King of East Francia

summary.en: Henry I, Duke of Saxony, was elected King of East Francia by the nobles at Fritzlar and formally crowned. He refused the church's anointing ritual, signifying that the king's authority came from the election of the nobility. Henry began building a cavalry force and constructing frontier castles to defend against the Magyars.

statement.en: Henry I, Duke of Saxony, was elected King of East Francia by the nobles at Fritzlar and formally crowned.

title.en: Yelu Abaoji creates the Khitan large script

summary.en: Emperor Taizu of Liao ordered Yelu Tulubu and others to create a Khitan large script of about three thousand characters, based on the shape of Chinese characters. This ideographic script was the beginning of a written language for the Khitan people. It was promulgated on stone tablets that same year.

statement.zh: 辽太祖耶律阿保机命耶律突吕不等人，参照汉字字形创制契丹大字三千余字。契丹大字是一种表意文字，同年立碑刊行。这是契丹民族拥有自己文字的开始。字形借用汉字的笔画与结构而另立音义，用于记功、诏令与碑铭；文字的创制使契丹的政令与纪事得以自立，也为后来的契丹小字提供基础。

title.en: Srivijaya declines due to civil strife

title.en: Al-Muqtadir becomes Abbasid caliph in Baghdad

summary.en: Al-Muqtadir, only thirteen years old, was proclaimed the 18th caliph of the Abbasid dynasty by the nobles. He reigned for twenty-five years, but real power was held by bureaucrats and the commanders of the guard, and the caliph's authority steadily declined.

statement.en:
Al-Muqtadir, only thirteen years old, was proclaimed the 18th caliph of the Abbasid dynasty by the nobles. He reigned for 25 years, but real power was held by bureaucrats and the commanders of the guard, and the caliph's authority steadily declined.

For Asia in 921 CE, “Al-Muqtadir becomes Abbasid caliph in Baghdad” is a traceable node of Politics change whose significance is best read through later events.

The entry is kept as a concise record of that wider process rather than a standalone narrative.

title.en: Li Cunxu indulges court actors, government degenerates

title.en: The Dayining kingdom is established in the former Nanzhao territory

summary.en: The Yunnan noble Yang Ganzhen usurped the Great Changhe Kingdom and established the Dayining kingdom. But Yang was cruel and unpopular; he was overthrown six years later by Duan Siping, and the Dali Kingdom era was about to begin.

statement.zh:
云南贵族杨干贞篡夺大长和国，建立大义宁国。但杨干贞残暴不仁，不得人心，六年后被段思平所灭，大理国时代即将开启。政权更替集中在洱海一带，地方贵族与佛教势力在其中举足轻重；杨干贞未能整合各方，段思平则以联合诸部起兵。云南由此进入大理国时期。

title.en: King Qian Liu of Wuyue builds a seawall at Qiantang

summary.en: Qian Liu, king of Wuyue, built a sea-defending stone embankment in Hangzhou Bay to resist tidal erosion. He used the "bamboo cage stone embankment" method: bamboo baskets filled with stones were stacked in layers, creating a sturdy anti-flood structure. The farmlands along the Qiantang estuary were thus protected.

statement.zh: 吴越王钱镠在杭州湾修建捍海石塘，以抵御海潮侵蚀。他采用“竹笼石塘”法，用竹篾编笼填塞石块，层层叠加，起到坚固的防潮效果。钱塘江口的农田因此得到保护。塘基以木桩固定、以石块垒砌，潮冲击时笼石相扣而不散；工程由军队与民夫分段修筑，海塘成为吴越水利的骨干。
statement.en: Qian Liu, King of Wuyue, built a sea-defending stone pond in Hangzhou Bay to resist sea tide erosion.

title.en: Byzantine Empire recruits the Varangian Guard

title.en: Liu Bin, later ruler of Southern Han, succeeds to the throne

summary.en: Liu Yan, the founder of Southern Han, died and was succeeded by his son Liu Bin (known as the Martyr of Southern Han). Liu Bin was extremely dissolute and ignored state affairs, entrusting the government to eunuchs and palace ladies. Three years later his brother Liu Sheng killed him and seized the throne.

title.en: Yelu Abaoji dies; his second son Yelu Deguang succeeds

summary.en: Emperor Taizu of Liao, Yelu Abaoji, died of illness at Fuyu Prefecture (present-day Nong'an, Jilin) on his way back from a campaign against the Balhae kingdom, at the age of fifty-five. Empress Dowager Shulü Ping acted as regent, deposing the crown prince Yelu Bei and elevating the second son, Yelu Deguang, to the throne as Emperor Taizong of Liao.

title.en: The Engi Shiki is finally completed and promulgated in Japan

summary.en: After two generations of effort under Emperor Daigo, the Engi Shiki in fifty volumes was finally completed and promulgated. title.en: Later Tang and the Khitans make peace

summary.en: Emperor Mingzong of Later Tang sent envoys to the Khitans to congratulate Yelu Deguang on his succession and present rich gifts. title.en: Tsar Peter I of Bulgaria ascends the throne

summary.en: Tsar Simeon I of Bulgaria died and was succeeded by his son Peter I. After his accession, Peter made peace with Byzantium, recognizing the Byzantine emperor as "father of the Bulgarian emperor" and marrying a Byzantine princess. Bulgaria turned toward peaceful development.

title.en: Emperor Taizong of Liao campaigns south, battles Later Tang at Youzhou

summary.en: Emperor Taizong of Liao led a large army south to attack Youzhou. The Later Tang generals Zhao Dejun and Zhao Yanshou defended the city, and the Khitan army besieged it for a long time without success. When Later Tang reinforcements arrived, the Liao army withdrew north, but not before carrying off a large number of captives and livestock.

title.en: King Ma Yin of Chu dies; Ma Xisheng succeeds

summary.en: Ma Yin, the founding monarch of the Chu Kingdom during the Five Dynasties and Ten Kingdoms period, died in Changsha at the age of seventy-nine. His son Ma Xisheng succeeded him, continuing to use the title of King of Chu. Ma Xisheng was extravagant and wasteful, and the power of Chu began to decline.

statement.zh: 五代十国时期楚国开国君主马殷在长沙去世，终年79岁。其子马希声继位，沿用楚王称号。马希声奢侈无度，楚国势力开始衰落。
statement.en:
Ma Yin, the founding monarch of the Chu Kingdom during the Five Dynasties and Ten Kingdoms period, died in Changsha at the age of 79. His son Ma Xisheng succeeded him, continuing to use the title of King of Chu. Ma Xisheng was extravagant and wasteful, and the power of Chu began to decline.

title.en: Fujiwara no Tadahira compiles the Engi Kyaku in Japan

title.en: Constitutional status of the Icelandic Althing is established

title.en: Emperor Mingzong of Later Tang reforms finances, reduces taxes

summary.en: Emperor Mingzong of Later Tang appointed Ren Huan as chancellor to reform state finances. He abolished various oppressive taxes imposed during Zhuangzong's reign, unifying land taxes into the "summer and autumn tax" of one dou of grain per mu. He also severely punished corrupt officials, allowing the local economy to recover.

statement.zh:
唐明宗李嗣源任命任圜为宰相，改革财政。他废除庄宗时期的各种苛捐杂税，统一土地税为“夏秋两税”，每亩纳粮一斗。同时严惩贪官，地方经济得到恢复。两税按田亩与户等征收，税率与征期趋于固定；度支与户部的账籍重新整理，军费与俸禄的支给出纳入常制。

把「唐明宗整顿财政，减轻赋税」放回公元930年的后唐，可以看到经济变化的一个具体切面。

title.en: Pagan Kingdom of Burma begins building a pagoda

summary.en: King Tannet of Pagan began constructing the first large pagoda, the Bu Paya Pagoda, on the banks of the Irrawaddy River. Fifty meters high, it marked the beginning of Buddhist architecture in Pagan. Over the next two hundred years, more than ten thousand pagodas would be built on the Pagan plain.

statement.zh: 蒲甘国王坦巴瓦开始建造第一座大型佛塔——卜帕耶塔。这座佛塔位于伊洛瓦底江畔，高50米，标志着蒲甘佛教建筑的开端。此后两百年间，蒲甘平原上修建了上万座佛塔。
statement.en:
In 930, King Tannet of Pagan began constructing the first large pagoda, the Bu Paya Pagoda, on the banks of the Irrawaddy River. 50 meters high, it marked the beginning of Buddhist architecture in Pagan. Over the next two hundred years, more than 10,000 pagodas would be built on the Pagan plain. In 930 CE, “Pagan Kingdom of Burma begins building a pagoda” belongs to the field of Religion in Asia. It sits within the timeline's chronological coverage of Pagan and religion history.

title.en: The Wakan Roeishū is compiled in Japan

summary.en: The Japanese scholar Fujiwara no Kintō compiled the Wakan Roeishū, a collection of famous lines from Chinese poets and Japanese waka poets. The book reflects the Heian aristocracy's aesthetic taste for both Chinese literature and native poetry.

statement.zh:
日本学者藤原公任编成《和汉朗咏集》，收录中国诗人和日本歌人吟诵的名句。把汉诗与和歌的名句并列在同一选本中，等于在编纂层面确认两种文学传统可以共存；该书因此反映了平安贵族崇尚汉文学又融合和歌的审美风尚。选本的形式本身就是一种文化态度。

把「日本《和汉朗咏集》编成」放回公元931年的日本，可以看到文学变化的一个具体切面。

title.en: Al-Azhar Mosque in Egypt establishes a university

summary.en: The Fatimid dynasty established a teaching institution at the Al-Azhar Mosque in Cairo, offering instruction in jurisprudence, grammar, and astronomy. It is considered one of the world's earliest universities, attracting Muslim scholars from far and wide.

title.en: Death of Harald Fairhair of Norway

summary.en: Around 932, Harald Fairhair, the first king of a unified Norway, died and was succeeded by his son Eric, known as 'Bloodaxe'. Eric was brutal and warlike, killing several of his brothers, and was driven out to Britain within a few years. Norway then fell into succession struggles until his brother Haakon I 'the Good' restored unity.

title.en: Later Tang begins block printing of the Nine Classics

summary.en: Feng Dao, chancellor of Later Tang, petitioned Emperor Mingzong to approve the block printing of the Confucian Nine Classics by the Directorate of Education. This was the first large-scale official block printing in Chinese history. It took twenty years to complete and promoted the dissemination of the Confucian classics.

title.en: King Ma Xifan of Chu expands Changsha

summary.en: Ma Xifan, king of Chu, expanded the city walls of Changsha, building the Huichun Garden and the Tiancefu Palace. He modeled his court on the Tang system, establishing the Eighteen Scholars of the Tiancefu to attract literati. Changsha became one of the important cultural centers of the Five Dynasties and Ten Kingdoms period.

title.en: Emperor Mingzong of Later Tang dies

summary.en: Emperor Mingzong of Later Tang, Li Siyuan, died of illness in Luoyang at the age of sixty-seven. During his eight-year reign he had worked hard and reduced the people's burdens, but in his later years he became suspicious and executed several high officials, leading to a struggle among his sons. His son Li Conghou succeeded him, known as Emperor Min.

title.en: Henry I of Germany defeats Danish Vikings

summary.en: Henry I, King of East Francia, led his army north, defeating the Danish Vikings at Schleswig. He captured Hedeby, forced the Danish king to submit, and established a market town there.

title.en: Persian poet Ferdowsi begins composing the Shahnameh

summary.en: Ferdowsi, a poet of the Samanid court, began composing the Shahnameh, a Persian national epic chronicling Persian myths and the lives of its kings. This monumental work took over thirty years and became a cornerstone of Persian culture.

statement.zh: 萨曼王朝宫廷诗人菲尔多西开始用波斯语创作民族史诗《列王纪》，系统讲述波斯神话和历代帝王故事。这部巨著耗时三十余年完成，成为波斯文化的基石。史诗把神话、传说与史事编为连贯叙事，以韵律与辞藻保存语言；宫廷的赞助与诗人的坚持共同支撑写作。波斯语由此获得不朽的经典。

title.en: Goryeo destroys Later Baekje and unifies the Later Three Kingdoms

summary.en: Gyeon Hwon, king of Later Baekje, was imprisoned at Geumsansa temple by his son Singeom after trying to pass over his eldest heir; in 935 he escaped and submitted to Goryeo, where Wang Geon honoured him as "Father of State". statement.zh: 后百济王甄萱因废长立幼，被其子神剑幽禁于金山寺，935年出逃投奔高丽，王建尊之为"尚父"。同年新罗敬顺王金傅自度不能自存，举国归附高丽，立国九百九十二年的新罗和平终结。936年王建亲率八万七千余众，与神剑决战于一利川（今庆尚北道善山），后百济军望旗溃散，神剑出降，立国45年的后百济灭亡。至此高丽统一后三国，结束了自新罗末年以来近半个世纪的分裂割据。
statement.en:
In 936, Gyeon Hwon, king of Later Baekje, was imprisoned at Geumsansa temple by his son Singeom after trying to pass over his eldest heir; in 935 he escaped and submitted to Goryeo, where Wang Geon honoured him as "Father of State". In the same year King Gyeongsun of Silla, judging his kingdom beyond saving, surrendered it peacefully to Goryeo, ending a dynasty of 992 years. In 936 Wang Geon personally led some 87,000 troops against Singeom at the Iricheon river (modern Seonsan, North Gyeongsang), the Later Baekje army broke at the sight of his banners and Singeom surrendered, ending the 45-year kingdom of Later Baekje. Goryeo had unified the Later Three Kingdoms, closing nearly half a century of division that had begun with the collapse of Silla.

For Asia in 936 CE, “Goryeo destroys Later Baekje and unifies the Later Three Kingdoms” is a traceable node of Politics change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.en: The Tengi Ritual is compiled in Japan

summary.en: The Japanese noble Fujiwara no Morosuke compiled the Tengi Ritual, standardizing court ceremonies and rituals. It is an important source on ancient Japanese ritual systems.

statement.zh:
日本贵族藤原师辅编纂完成《天德礼仪》，规范朝廷祭祀和典礼仪式。该书是研究古代日本礼仪制度的重要文献。内容涵盖即位、朝贺、祭祀与丧葬等仪节，规定次序、服饰与器物，把律令时代的礼制整理成可操作的规范。后世仪式多以其为据。

statement.zh: 后晋高祖石敬瑭派遣使者赴辽，奉表称臣，尊辽太宗耶律德光为“父皇帝”，自称“儿皇帝”。辽太宗册封石敬瑭为“晋国皇帝”。这是中原王朝对外族称臣的罕见案例。
statement.en:
Emperor Gaozu of Later Jin dispatched an envoy to Liao, presenting a memorial in which he declared himself a subject and addressed Liao Taizong Yelu Deguang as his "father emperor," referring to himself as the "son emperor." Liao Taizong in turn conferred on Shi Jingtang the title of "Emperor of Jin." This was a rare case of a Central Plains dynasty acknowledging a foreign state as its superior.

For Asia in 938 CE, “Shi Jingtang honors Liao Taizong as his father emperor” is a traceable node of Diplomacy change whose significance is best read through later events.

zh: 后晋高祖石敬瑭派遣使者赴辽，奉表称臣，尊辽太宗耶律德光为“父皇帝”，自称“儿皇帝”。辽太宗册封石敬瑭为“晋国皇帝”。这是中原王朝对外族称臣的罕见案例。

statement.en: A monk from western India known in Korean sources as Hongbeom travelled east to the Goryeo capital of Kaegyeong, where Taejo Wang Geon received him with full state honours — a rare instance of direct contact between the Korean peninsula and the Indian homeland of Buddhism.

en: A monk from western India known in Korean sources as Hongbeom travelled east to the Goryeo capital of Kaegyeong, where Taejo Wang Geon received him with full state honours — a rare instance of direct contact between the Korean peninsula and the Indian homeland of Buddhism.

note.zh: 批量上下文重写；事实待来源核验

statement.zh: 高丽自开国便奉佛教为护国之教，太祖于开京创法王寺等十寺，又定燃灯会、八关会为岁时国典，《训要十条》更以"国家大业必资诸佛护卫之力"列为第一训。
statement.en: Goryeo had venerated Buddhism as the protector of the state from its founding: Taejo built ten temples in Kaegyeong including Beopwangsa, fixed the Lantern Festival and the Palgwanhoe as annual state rites, and made "the great work of the state rests on the protecting power of the Buddhas" the first of his Ten Injunctions.

en: Goryeo had venerated Buddhism as the protector of the state from its founding: Taejo built ten temples in Kaegyeong including Beopwangsa, fixed the Lantern Festival and the Palgwanhoe as annual state rites, and made "the great work of the state rests on the protecting power of the Buddhas" the first of his Ten Injunctions.

title.en: Ngo Quyen proclaims himself king, Vietnam becomes independent

title.en: Magyars plunder Burgundy in France

title.en: Emperor Suzaku of Japan ascends the throne

summary.en: In the second year of the Tengyō era (939 CE), Emperor Suzaku ascended the throne. He was the 61st emperor of Japan. During his reign (930–946 CE, reign era changed to Tengyō in 936), the rebellion of Taira no Masakado (939 CE) and the rebellion of Fujiwara no Sumitomo (Tengyō–Jōhei Rebellion) broke out, having a profound impact on Japanese history.

statement.zh: 日本天庆二年（公元939年），朱雀天皇即位。朱雀天皇是日本第61代天皇，在位期间（930-946年/改元后为936-944年）爆发了平将门之乱（939年）和藤原纯友之乱（承平天庆之乱），对日本历史产生了深远影响。
statement.en:
In the second year of the Tengyō era (939 CE), Emperor Suzaku ascended the throne. He was the 61st emperor of Japan. During his reign (930–946 CE, reign era changed to Tengyō in 936), the rebellion of Taira no Masakado (939 CE) and the rebellion of Fujiwara no Sumitomo (Tengyō–Jōhei Rebellion) broke out, having a profound impact on Japanese history.

For Asia in 939 CE, “Emperor Suzaku of Japan ascends the throne” is a traceable node of Politics change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.en: Later Shu casts Guangzheng Tongbao coins

summary.en: Emperor Meng Chang of Later Shu cast "Guangzheng Tongbao" copper coins, standardizing currency in Shu. The economy of Later Shu prospered, and it was called the "Land of Abundance." However, Meng Chang was extravagant, using copper for palace construction, which led to inflation.

title.en: Pala dynasty builds temples in Bengal

summary.en: Mahipala I, king of the Pala dynasty in Bengal, built the Odantapuri temple near Nalanda, dedicated to Buddhist Vajrayana. The Pala dynasty was the last major Buddhist dynasty in the Indian subcontinent; its architectural style influenced Buddhist art in Southeast Asia.

statement.zh: 孟加拉帕拉王朝国王摩希波罗一世在那烂陀附近修建奥丹塔普里寺，供奉佛教金刚乘。帕拉王朝是印度次大陆最后一个大乘佛教王朝，其建筑风格影响了东南亚佛教艺术。寺院以砖砌殿堂与雕刻装饰，兼具经院与密教仪轨；王朝的庇护使佛教在孟加拉延续，僧侣与经典随商路传播。
statement.en: Mahipalā I, King of the Pala Dynasty of Bengal, built the Odantapuri Temple near Nalanda to worship Vajrayana Buddhism.

title.en: Li Bian of Southern Tang reforms tax laws

summary.en: Li Bian, Emperor of Southern Tang, implemented a tax reform based on field measurement, abolishing various surtaxes from the Wu period and establishing a "seed loan" to help farmers buy seeds. Southern Tang agriculture thus recovered and grew.

statement.zh:
南唐烈祖李昪实行“按田亩征税”改革，废除吴国时期的杂税，并设立“贷种钱”资助农民购买种子。按田亩征税把税基落到土地上，废除杂税则减少重复征收；贷种钱在播种环节提供周转，使税制调整与生产恢复相互配合。南唐农业因此恢复发展。

把「南唐李昪改革税法」放回公元940年的南唐，可以看到经济变化的一个具体切面。
statement.en: Li Bian, founder of the Southern Tang, carried out a tax reform based on field measurement, abolished the miscellaneous levies of the Wu period, and set up a 'seed loan' to help farmers buy seed.

title.en: Emperor Gaozu of Later Jin dies

summary.en: Shi Jingtang died of illness in Luoyang at the age of fifty-one. His nephew Shi Chonggui succeeded him, known as Emperor Chu. The new emperor refused to continue calling himself a subject of the Khitans, leading to a breakdown in relations and eventually a Liao campaign that would destroy Later Jin.

Shi Jingtang died of illness in Luoyang at the age of 51. His nephew Shi Chonggui succeeded him, known as Emperor Chu. The new emperor refused to continue calling himself a subject of the Khitans, leading to a breakdown in relations and eventually a Liao campaign that would destroy Later Jin.

title.en: Chinese calligrapher Yang Ningshi creates the Leek Flower Letter

summary.en: The Five Dynasties calligrapher Yang Ningshi created the Leek Flower Letter (Jiuhua Tie) in Luoyang, a semi-cursive script work of elegant and free brushwork. It became an important model for later students of semi-cursive script.

statement.zh:
五代书法家杨凝式在洛阳创作行书《韭花帖》，笔法秀逸洒脱，介于真行之间。该帖成为后世学习行书的重要范本。作品以日常短札为内容，字形疏密有致、行气贯通，把楷书的法度与行书的流动结合；后世书家多临习其笔意。

把「中国书法家杨凝式创作《韭花帖》」放回公元941年的中原，可以看到文化变化的一个具体切面。

title.en: Taejo of Goryeo issues the Ten Injunctions on his deathbed

summary.en: Sensing that his end was near, Taejo Wang Geon summoned the high minister Bak Sul-hui and personally handed down the Ten Injunctions as a charter of rule for his successors: the state depends on the protection of the Buddhas, yet no new temples should be founded lest the geomantic veins be harmed; the throne should pass to the worthiest, to a younger son or even to a prince cho

statement.zh: 高丽太祖王建自知不豫，召大匡朴述希入内，亲授《训要十条》，为后世君主立治国之纲：国家大业赖诸佛护卫。然寺院不可妄增以免地脉损伤；嗣君当择贤，长子不肖则授次子、再不肖则授群臣所推者；效法唐朝典章而不必尽同，契丹乃禽兽之国，其语言风俗不可仿效。西京（平壤）为地脉根本，君王宜岁时巡幸；轻徭薄赋、慎用刑赏，广读经史以古为鉴。此十训被高丽历朝奉为祖宗成宪，影响国政近五百年。
statement.en: In 943, sensing that his end was near, Taejo Wang Geon summoned the high minister Bak Sul-hui and personally handed down the Ten Injunctions as a charter of rule for his successors: the state depends on the protection of the Buddhas, yet no new temples should be founded lest the geomantic veins be harmed; the throne should pass to the worthiest, to a younger son or even to a prince chosen by the ministers if the eldest is unfit; Tang institutions should be studied but not copied wholesale, while the Khitan are a nation of beasts whose language and customs must never be imitated; the Western Capital at Pyongyang is the root of the land's vital energy and the king should visit it regularly; taxes and corvée should be light, punishment and reward used sparingly, and the histories read as a mirror. Later Goryeo kings treated the injunctions as ancestral law for nearly 500 years.

en: In 943, sensing that his end was near, Taejo Wang Geon summoned the high minister Bak Sul-hui and personally handed down the Ten Injunctions as a charter of rule for his successors: the state depends on the protection of the Buddhas, yet no new temples should be founded lest the geomantic veins be harmed; the throne should pass to the worthiest, to a younger son or even to a prince chosen by the ministers if the eldest is unfit; Tang institutions should be studied but not copied wholesale, while the Khitan are a nation of beasts whose language and customs must never be imitated; the Western Capital at Pyongyang is the root of the land's vital energy and the king should visit it regularly; taxes and corvée should be light, punishment and reward used sparingly, and the histories read as a mirror. Later Goryeo kings treated the injunctions as ancestral law for nearly 500 years.

title.en: Taejo Wang Geon of Goryeo dies; Hyejong ascends the throne

summary.en: Taejo Wang Geon of Goryeo died at Kaegyeong after a reign of twenty-six years, aged sixty-seven. Wang Geon had bound the regional strongmen to himself through marriage, taking twenty-nine consorts who bore him twenty-five sons and nine daughters; this secured the political coalition that founded the dynasty but also planted the seeds of savage feuding between princes and consor

statement.zh: 在位26年的高丽太祖王建病逝于开京，年六十七，庙号太祖。王建以联姻笼络各地豪族，前后纳二十九位后妃、生二十五子九女，虽以此稳住了开国的政治联盟，却也埋下宗室与外戚倾轧的祸根。长子王武继位，是为惠宗，因母族势弱，屡遭权臣王规谋害，日夜持刀而卧，在位仅两年即忧惧而终。此后定宗、光宗相继即位，高丽王权历三朝清洗方才稳固。
statement.en:
Taejo Wang Geon of Goryeo died at Kaegyeong after a reign of 26 years, aged 67. Wang Geon had bound the regional strongmen to himself through marriage, taking 29 consorts who bore him 25 sons and nine daughters; this secured the political coalition that founded the dynasty but also planted the seeds of savage feuding between princes and consort clans. His eldest son Wang Mu succeeded him as Hyejong, but with a weak maternal family he was repeatedly targeted for assassination by the minister Wang Gyu, slept with a sword at hand, and died worn out by fear after only two years. Jeongjong and then Gwangjong followed, and it took three reigns of purges before royal authority in Goryeo was secure.

For Asia in 943 CE, “Taejo Wang Geon of Goryeo dies; Hyejong ascends the throne” is a traceable node of Politics change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.en: Classical Maya civilization completely collapses

summary.en: The classical Maya cities of the southern lowlands—Palenque, Tikal, Copán, and others—were abandoned, and the population declined sharply. A combination of drought, warfare, and social collapse ended the classical Maya civilization. Northern cities like Chichen Itza continued to exist.

statement.zh: 玛雅南部低地的古典城邦帕伦克、蒂卡尔、科潘等被废弃，人口急剧下降。干旱、战争和社会崩溃多重原因导致古典玛雅文明终结。北部的奇琴伊察等城邦继续存在。城邦的王权与祭祀体系在灾变中瓦解，农田与水利失修；雨林的扩张掩埋了宫殿与石碑，北方的尤卡坦则延续了新的繁荣。

title.en: Liao Taizong withdraws north; Later Han occupies Kaifeng

summary.en: Unable to hold the Central Plains, Liao Taizong Yelu Deguang led his army back north and died on the way at Luancheng (present-day Luancheng, Hebei). Emperor Gaozu of Later Han, Liu Zhiyuan, seized the opportunity to enter Kaifeng and made it his capital, changing the reign title to Qianyou. Later Han formally replaced Later Jin as the Central Plains dynasty.

statement.zh: 辽太宗耶律德光在中原无法立足，率军北返。途中病逝于栾城（今河北栾城）。后汉高祖刘知远乘机进入开封，定都于此，改元乾祐。后汉正式取代后晋统治中原。
statement.en:
Unable to hold the Central Plains, Liao Taizong Yelu Deguang led his army back north and died on the way at Luancheng (present-day Luancheng, Hebei). Emperor Gaozu of Later Han, Liu Zhiyuan, seized the opportunity to enter Kaifeng and made it his capital, changing the reign title to Qianyou. Later Han formally replaced Later Jin as the Central Plains dynasty.

title.en: The Teishin Kōki is compiled in Japan

summary.en: The Japanese noble Fujiwara no Tadahira personally wrote the diary Teishin Kōki, which records court ceremonies, personnel changes, and social customs, making it an important historical source for the mid-Heian period.

statement.zh:
日本贵族藤原忠平亲自撰写日记《贞信公记》，记录了朝廷仪式、人事变动和社会风俗，是研究平安时代中期历史的重要史料。日记以汉文书写，逐日记载政务与仪礼，兼及贵族生活与传闻；作者身处高位，记录具有亲历性。它为后世提供了宫廷运作的细节。

把「日本《贞信公记》编纂」放回公元947年的日本，可以看到文化变化的一个具体切面。

title.en: Li Yichao asserts independence; Dingnan military command becomes autonomous

summary.en: Li Yichao, chief of the Tangut tribe, took advantage of the chaos in Later Han to declare that the Dingnan military command would be hereditary and would not pay tribute to the court. This was a key step toward the independence of the Dingnan command, the predecessor of the Western Xia.

statement.zh:
党项族首领李彝超因后汉内部混乱，宣布定难军节度使世袭，不向朝廷纳贡。这是西夏前身定难军独立的关键一步。定难军据有夏州一带，兼有畜牧与贸易之利；世袭化使地方军政与部落首领结合，朝廷的任命逐渐形式化。割据由此在西北边地成形。

把「李彝超独立，定难军割据」放回公元947年的党项，可以看到政治变化的一个具体切面。

title.en: Bagrat III of Georgia unifies the country

summary.en: Bagrat III inherited the throne of Abkhazia and later that of Kartli, unifying eastern and western Georgia. He established the Bagratid dynasty and made Kutaisi his capital. Georgia became an independent kingdom.

statement.zh: 巴格拉特三世继承阿布哈兹国王之位后，又继承卡尔特利王位，统一了格鲁吉亚东西两部。他建立了巴格拉特王朝，定都库塔伊西。格鲁吉亚从此成为独立王国。
statement.en: After Bagrat III succeeded to the throne of Abkhazia, he also succeeded to the throne of Kartli and unified the eastern and western parts of Georgia.

title.en: Southern Tang general Bian Hao destroys the Chu kingdom

summary.en: Emperor Yuanzong Li Jing of Southern Tang sent his general Bian Hao with an army to storm Changsha, the capital of Chu. King Ma Xichong of Chu surrendered, and the Chu kingdom fell. Southern Tang temporarily controlled the middle Yangtze, but the military expenditure was so large that it soon lost its ability to rule effectively.

title.en: Great plague in Huainan, Southern Tang

summary.en: In the seventh year of the Baoda reign (949 CE), a massive plague broke out in the Huainan region (present-day Anhui and northern Jiangsu) of Southern Tang. title.en: Abbot Odo of Cluny becomes famous for his reforms

summary.en: Abbot Odo of Cluny died. During his tenure he vigorously enforced the Rule of Saint Benedict, requiring monks to withdraw from the secular world and to devote themselves only to prayer and labor. The Abbey of Cluny became a center of religious reform in Europe.

statement.zh: 克吕尼修道院院长奥多去世。他在任期间大力推行本笃会规，要求修士远离世俗，只从事祈祷和劳动。克吕尼修道院成为欧洲宗教改革的中心。奥多曾在乡间隐修，主张以严格的礼仪与静默恢复修道生活；克吕尼直属教皇、不受地方主教与领主干预，其分院网络由此扩张，为教会改革提供了范本。

title.en: Kilwa becomes an East African trade hub

summary.en: The East African coastal city-state of Kilwa (present-day Tanzania) began minting its own copper coins and became a center of the gold and ivory trade. The rulers of Kilwa controlled the export of gold from the Sofala mines (in modern Mozambique), making them immensely wealthy.

statement.zh: 东非沿海城邦基尔瓦（今坦桑尼亚）开始铸造自己的铜币，成为黄金和象牙贸易的中心。基尔瓦统治者控制着索法拉（今莫桑比克）金矿的出口，富甲一方。港口以珊瑚石筑屋、以独桅帆船往来，黄金、象牙与布料在此转输；城邦的财富支撑清真寺与宫殿，也引来内陆与海上的竞争。
statement.en: The East African coastal city-state of Kilwa (present-day Tanzania) began minting its own copper coins and became a center for the gold and ivory trade.

statement.zh: 约公元950年前后（晚唐至五代），道教炼丹著作《真元妙道要略》记载了硝石、硫黄与可燃物混合引发的爆燃现象："有以硫黄、雄黄合硝石并蜜烧之，焰起，烧手面及烬屋舍者。"这是世界上关于火药配方及其危险性的最早文字记录，说明中国炼丹家在追求长生药的过程中意外发现了火药。此后火药于唐末五代开始用于军事，至宋代出现火箭、火球、霹雳炮等成体系的火器。
statement.en:
In 950, around the middle of the tenth century, in the late Tang to Five Dynasties period, the Daoist alchemical text Zhenyuan Miaodao Yaolüe recorded the deflagration caused by mixing saltpetre and sulphur with combustible matter: "Some have burnt sulphur, realgar, saltpetre and honey together; flames leap up, burning their hands and faces and even burning down the house." It is the earliest written record anywhere of a gunpowder mixture and of its dangers, and shows that Chinese alchemists stumbled on gunpowder while seeking an elixir of immortality. Gunpowder began to be used in war at the end of the Tang and under the Five Dynasties, and by the Song there were fire arrows, fire balls and other systematic firearms.

In 950 CE, “Earliest recorded formula for gunpowder” belongs to the field of Technology in Asia.

For Asia in 950 CE, “Earliest recorded formula for gunpowder” is a traceable node of Technology change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.en: Al-Farabi on the virtuous city

summary.en: Al-Farabi (c. 870-950) recast political philosophy in a Neoplatonic key, writing the 'Virtuous City' and earning the title 'the Second Teacher' after Aristotle; his works on logic and music shaped Arabic learning.

title.en: The voyager Kupe reaches Aotearoa

summary.en: In Maori tradition the navigator Kupe sailed from Polynesia to Aotearoa (New Zealand), opening the memory of Maori migration.

title.en: Japanese poetry anthology Mura no Miyuki compiled

summary.en: Emperor Murakami of Japan ordered the compilation of the waka anthology Mura no Miyuki, which collected excellent works by court poets. This period is considered the peak of Japanese waka poetry.

statement.zh:
日本村上天皇命人编选《村御幸》和歌集，收录了宫廷歌人的优秀作品。这一时期被认为是日本和歌艺术的高峰。选集以四季与恋歌为题，讲究词藻与声调，反映宫廷贵族的审美；编选活动也推动了和歌的整理与传授。

把「日本《村御幸》歌集编成」放回公元952年的日本，可以看到文学变化的一个具体切面。
statement.en: Emperor Murakami of Japan ordered people to compile and select "Mura Miyuki", a collection of Japanese songs, which included the outstanding works of court singers.

title.en: Later Zhou suppresses the rebellion of Murong Yanchao

summary.en: Emperor Taizu of Later Zhou personally led a campaign to Yanzhou to suppress the rebellion of the military governor Murong Yanchao, who set himself on fire and died. Guo Wei ordered a reduction in taxes and a stabilization of local order.

title.en: Byzantine Emperor Constantine VII completes De Administrando Imperio

summary.en: Constantine VII of Byzantium completed De Administrando Imperio, a detailed account of the Byzantine Empire's diplomatic relations and administrative systems with neighboring peoples. It is an important source on 10th-century international relations.

statement.zh: 拜占庭皇帝君士坦丁七世著成《帝国行政论》一书，详细记述了拜占庭帝国与周边民族的外交关系和行政制度。该书是研究10世纪国际关系的重要文献。书中列述邻邦的习俗、地理与用兵之道，兼载宫廷的外交守则；皇帝为继承人写下治国须知。它把帝国视野整理成可操作的指南。
statement.en: The Byzantine Emperor Constantine VII wrote the book "On the Administration of the Empire", which described in detail the diplomatic relations and administrative system of the Byzantine Empire and surrounding peoples.

title.en: Southern Tang emperor Li Jing moves the capital to Nanchang

summary.en: To avoid the threat of Later Zhou, Emperor Li Jing of Southern Tang moved his capital from Jinling to Hongzhou (present-day Nanchang), renaming it Nan Du (Southern Capital). However, due to opposition from his ministers, he soon moved it back to Jinling.

statement.zh: 南唐中主李璟为躲避后周威胁，将都城从金陵迁至洪州（今南昌），改称南都。但不久后因为大臣反对，又迁回金陵。迁都是对北方压力的应急反应，洪州地处内陆、便于退守，却远离江淮财赋与交通中心；朝臣顾虑迁都动摇人心与政权根基。来回迁徙暴露了南唐战略上的被动。

title.en: Karakhanids conquer Transoxiana

summary.en: The Karakhanids captured Bukhara and Samarkand, the capitals of the Samanids, completely swallowing up Transoxiana. The last Samanid king fled into exile. The Karakhanids became the dominant power in Central Asia.

statement.zh:
喀喇汗王朝攻占萨曼尼王朝的首都布哈拉和撒马尔罕，彻底吞并河中地区，萨曼尼末代国王流亡。喀喇汗王朝成为中亚霸主。征服以骑兵与绿洲城市的争夺展开，商路与灌溉网随之易主；突厥政权与波斯行政传统结合。中亚的政治与文化版图由此改写。

把「喀喇汗王朝征服河中地区」放回公元953年的喀喇汗王朝，可以看到军事变化的一个具体切面。

title.en: Otto I crushes a rebellion in Swabia

summary.en: Otto I's son Ludolf, in alliance with Swabian nobles, rebelled. Otto laid siege to the rebel castle; Ludolf eventually surrendered and was pardoned but lost his title and lands.

statement.zh:
奥托一世之子鲁道夫联合士瓦本贵族叛乱。奥托一世围困叛乱城堡，最终鲁道夫投降，被赦免但失去领地和头衔。叛乱源于王位继承与领地分配的分歧，贵族借机扩张势力；围城战持续日久，双方以谈判收场。奥托借平叛重申王权对公爵的控制。

把「奥托一世镇压士瓦本叛乱」放回公元954年的东法兰克，可以看到军事变化的一个具体切面。

title.en: Guo Wei dies; Chai Rong succeeds

summary.en: Emperor Taizu of Later Zhou, Guo Wei, died of illness and was succeeded by his adopted son Chai Rong, known as Emperor Shizong of Later Zhou. Chai Rong, the most outstanding monarch of the Five Dynasties, vowed to "spend ten years opening up the realm, ten years nurturing the people, and ten years bringing about great peace." He immediately launched a series of reforms.

statement.zh: 后周太祖郭威病逝，养子柴荣继位，是为周世宗。柴荣是五代最杰出的君主，立志“十年开拓天下，十年养百姓，十年致太平”。他随即进行一系列改革。
statement.en:
Emperor Taizu of Later Zhou, Guo Wei, died of illness and was succeeded by his adopted son Chai Rong, known as Emperor Shizong of Later Zhou. Chai Rong, the most outstanding monarch of the Five Dynasties, vowed to "spend ten years opening up the realm, ten years nurturing the people, and ten years bringing about great peace." He immediately launched a series of reforms.

For Asia in 954 CE, “Guo Wei dies; Chai Rong succeeds” is a traceable node of Politics change whose significance is best read through later events.

statement.zh: 北汉主刘旻联合契丹骑兵南侵，周世宗柴荣亲征。两军在高平（今山西晋城）激战。周军右翼溃败，柴荣亲率近卫骑兵冲锋，斩杀北汉大将张元徽。刘旻溃逃，契丹退兵。此战巩固了柴荣的地位。
statement.en:
Liu Min of Northern Han invaded the south with Khitan cavalry. Emperor Shizong of Later Zhou led his army in person to meet them. The two armies fought fiercely at Gaoping (present-day Jincheng, Shanxi). The right flank of the Zhou army collapsed, but Chai Rong led his own elite cavalry in a charge, killing the Northern Han general Zhang Yuanhui. Liu Min fled in panic, and the Khitans withdrew. This battle secured Chai Rong's position.

title.en: Fujiwara regency promotes the Engi Shiki in Japan

summary.en: Chancellor Fujiwara no Saneyori forced the implementation of the provisions of the Engi Shiki, cracking down on illegal private estates of local strongmen and increasing government revenue. However, local resistance was strong, and the reforms had limited effect.

statement.zh:
日本关白藤原实赖强制推行《延喜式》中的规定，打击地方豪强的非法庄园，扩大朝廷收入。但地方反抗强烈，改革效果有限。式目把税赋、仪礼与官制整理成规范，朝廷借以约束国司与庄园；豪族以拖延与抵制回应。中央与地方的博弈延续。

把「日本藤原氏推动《延喜式》实施」放回公元956年的日本，可以看到政治变化的一个具体切面。

title.en: Walls of Damascus are rebuilt

summary.en: The Hamdanids rebuilt the walls and citadel of Damascus, which had been damaged by an earthquake, to defend against Byzantine attacks. Damascus once again became a military stronghold in northern Syria.

title.en: Later Zhou again campaigns against Southern Tang

summary.en: Emperor Shizong of Later Zhou launched a second southern campaign, capturing Shouzhou (present-day Shou County, Anhui) from Southern Tang and taking the Southern Tang general Liu Renzhan prisoner. Southern Tang completely lost its Huai River defenses and sent envoys to sue for peace.

statement.zh:

title.en: Mieszko I of Poland establishes the Piast dynasty

summary.en: Mieszko I, Duke of Poland, united the Polish tribes along the Warta River and established the Piast dynasty. He allied with the Holy Roman Empire and married the Czech princess Dobrawa.

statement.zh:
波兰公爵梅什科一世统一了瓦尔特河畔的波兰各部落，建立了皮亚斯特王朝。他与神圣罗马帝国结盟，并娶捷克公主为妻。联姻与结盟把部落联盟纳入拉丁基督教世界，接受洗礼与教会组织随之而来；王权的合法性由外部承认与内部整合共同支撑。

title.en: Japan compiles the Hyakka Myōshū

summary.en: The Japanese scholar Minamoto no Shitagō compiled the twenty-volume Hyakka Myōshū, a classified Sino-Japanese dictionary containing definitions of words in astronomy, geography, history, official posts, and other fields.

日本学者源顺编成《百科名集》二十卷，是一部汉和分类辞典，收录了天文、地理、历史、官职等各类词语的释义。辞典按门类编排，以汉文词条配和训与解释，便于阅读汉籍与写作；它保存了大量古代语汇与制度知识。

title.en: Gwangjong of Goryeo institutes the civil service examination

summary.en: In the ninth year of King Gwangjong, on the advice of Ssang Gi, a defector from Later Zhou, Goryeo held its first civil service examinations, with tracks in composition (jinsa), classics (myeonggyeong) and technical specialities, recruiting officials by poetry, exegesis and professional skill rather than by pedigree, and building a corps of literati loyal to the throne alone. en: Two years earlier, in 956, Gwangjong had enforced the Slave Review Act, investigating free commoners seized as slaves by the magnate families during the wars of unification and restoring their status, which stripped the merit aristocracy of their private retainers and troops; in 960 he further fixed four colours of official robes — purple, crimson.

title.en: Chai Rong campaigns north against the Khitans, recovers Guannan

summary.en: Emperor Shizong of Later Zhou personally led a campaign against the Khitans, capturing Ningzhou, Mozhou, Yingzhou, Yizhou, and other prefectures. He recovered three prefectures and seven counties of the Sixteen Prefectures of Yanyun. Just as he was about to attack Youzhou, Chai Rong suddenly fell gravely ill and withdrew his army south.

statement.zh: 周世宗柴荣亲自率军北伐契丹，连克宁州、莫州、瀛州、易州等地，收复了燕云十六州中的关南三州七县。正当准备进攻幽州时，柴荣突然病重，撤兵南返。
statement.en:
Emperor Shizong of Later Zhou personally led a campaign against the Khitans, capturing Ningzhou, Mozhou, Yingzhou, Yizhou, and other prefectures. He recovered three prefectures and seven counties of the Sixteen Prefectures of Yanyun. Just as he was about to attack Youzhou, Chai Rong suddenly fell gravely ill and withdrew his army south.

For Asia in 959 CE, “Chai Rong campaigns north against the Khitans, recovers Guannan” is a traceable node of Military change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.en: Mieszko I of Poland accepts Christianity

summary.en: To avoid invasion by the Holy Roman Empire, Mieszko I, Duke of Poland, accepted Latin Christianity and married the Czech princess Dobrawa. Poland thus joined the Christian world.

statement.zh:
波兰公爵梅什科一世为免遭神圣罗马帝国入侵，接受拉丁基督教洗礼，并娶捷克公主多布拉瓦为妻。波兰从此加入基督教世界。皈依把波兰纳入拉丁教会与西方政治秩序，婚姻则带来波希米亚的联盟与传教支持；本土信仰在乡间延续。宗教与外交由此合一。

title.en: Song brocade becomes a celebrated weave

summary.en: Song-dynasty Suzhou brocade, known for disciplined structure and elegant pattern, was used for mounting scrolls and robes, ranking among China's three great brocades.

statement.en: Suzhou brocade in the Song Dynasty is famous for its rigorous organization and elegant patterns.

title.en: Chenqiao Mutiny: Zhao Kuangyin establishes the Song dynasty

summary.en: Zhao Kuangyin, the commander of the palace guard of Later Zhou, was proclaimed emperor by his troops at Chenqiao (present-day Fengqiu, Henan) in a mutiny. statement.zh: 后周殿前都点检赵匡胤在陈桥驿（今河南封丘）被部下黄袍加身，拥立为帝。他回师开封，迫使幼主柴宗训禅位，建国号宋，定都开封，史称北宋。赵匡胤即宋太祖。他随即“杯酒释兵权”，削夺禁军将领兵权，以文制武，结束了五代武将专权的局面。
statement.en:
Zhao Kuangyin, the commander of the palace guard of Later Zhou, was proclaimed emperor by his troops at Chenqiao (present-day Fengqiu, Henan) in a mutiny. He returned to Kaifeng and forced the young Chai Zongxun to abdicate, founding the Song dynasty with its capital at Kaifeng, historically known as the Northern Song. Zhao Kuangyin, Emperor Taizu of Song, subsequently "released military power over a cup of wine" (beijiu shi bingquan), stripping his generals of command and substituting civilian control, thereby ending the phenomenon of military domination that had characterized the Five Dynasties.

For Asia in 960 CE, “Chenqiao Mutiny: Zhao Kuangyin establishes the Song dynasty” is a traceable node of Politics change whose significance is best read through later events.

statement.zh: 960年，后周禁军将领赵匡胤在都城外的军营被部下拥立为帝，回师开封建立宋朝；他收夺将领兵权，至976年基本平定南方。
statement.en: In 960 Zhao Kuangyin, a Later Zhou commander, was acclaimed emperor by his troops at a bridge outside the capital; he returned to Kaifeng, founded the Song dynasty, curbed the generals' power, and by 976 had mastered all but the northern rival state.

sources.locator: Section 'Early life and rise to power', paragraphs 2–4
sources.excerpt: When the army was encamped for the night at a bridge outside the capital, the officers awakened Zhao (who had drunk well before retiring), hailed him as emperor, robed him in imperial yellow, mounted him on horseback, and urged him to return and take over the government. He named his dynasty the Song. By 976 all but the northern rival house were mastered.

zh: 后周殿前都点检赵匡胤在陈桥驿（今河南封丘）被部下黄袍加身，拥立为帝。
en: Zhao Kuangyin, the commander of the palace guard of Later Zhou, was proclaimed emperor by his troops at Chenqiao (present-day Fengqiu, Henan) in a mutiny.

note.zh: 来源记赵匡胤在都城外的桥边军营被拥立、建宋，至976年除北汉外基本平定南方，并以荣衔收回将领兵权；事件标陈桥驿、黄袍加身、柴宗训禅位、杯酒释兵权，来源未点名陈桥与柴宗训，claim 只保留拥立、建宋、收兵权与976年统一进度。
note.en: The source places the acclamation at a bridge outside the capital, records the founding of Song, the reduction of generals' power, and the mastery of all but the northern rival by 976; the event names Chenqiao, the yellow robe, Chai Zongxun's abdication, and the 'cup of wine' release of military power, none of which is named in the same passage, so the claim keeps only the acclamation, founding, curb on generals, and the 976 unification progress.

title.en: Northern Song capital at Kaifeng

summary.en: In 960 the Northern Song makes Kaifeng its eastern capital. Fed by the Bian canal and its night markets, it grows past a million people into one of the largest and most prosperous cities of the time, immortalised in Along the River During the Qingming Festival.

statement.zh:
960年，北宋以开封为东京，作为首都。汴河漕运把南方物资汇入城市，夜市与街肆则延长了城市生活的时间；两者共同支撑起逾百万的人口规模，使其成为当时世界上最大、最繁华的城市之一。《清明上河图》所写的正是这种城市盛况。

把「北宋定都东京」放回公元960年的中国，可以看到城市变化的一个具体切面。

title.en: Zhuang brocade rises in Lingnan

summary.en: Zhuang weavers of Lingnan produced brocade with cotton-silk blend, geometric motifs and vivid color, a major ethnic textile tradition.

statement.zh:
壮族先民在岭南织造壮锦，以棉丝交织、几何花纹与浓烈色彩为特征，是重要的民族织锦。织造以通经断纬与挑花起花，图案多取菱形、水波与花鸟，色彩以红、黄、蓝为主；锦料用于被面、背带与礼服。技艺以母女传统说法认为，成为族群身份的标记。

把「壮锦在岭南兴起」放回公元960年的中国，可以看到工艺变化的一个具体切面。

title.en: Byzantine general Nikephoros Phokas recovers Crete

summary.en: On 6 March 961, the Byzantine general Nikephoros Phokas stormed Chandax (modern Heraklion), capital of the Emirate of Crete. His expedition had landed in the summer of 960 and besieged the city through the winter, completing the reconquest of the island by May 961. title.en: The Kagerō Nikki is written in Japan

summary.en: The Japanese noblewoman Fujiwara no Michitsuna no Haha began writing the autobiographical Kagerō Nikki (Gossamer Years), telling of her unhappy marriage. It is a classic of Japanese women's literature.

statement.zh:
日本贵族女性藤原道纲母开始撰写自传体日记《蜻蛉日记》，记述自己不幸福的婚姻生活。这是日本女性文学的经典作品。日记以和文书写，把私人情感、家庭关系与宫廷社交织入日常叙事；女性作者以自省与观察确立独特的文体。它开创了日记文学的传统。

把「日本《蜻蛉日记》创作」放回公元962年的日本，可以看到文学变化的一个具体切面。

statement.zh: 962年12月，拜占庭东方统帅尼基弗鲁斯·福卡斯与外甥约翰·齐米斯基斯冬季奇袭叙利亚北部重镇阿勒颇，连败哈姆丹王朝将领纳贾与埃米尔赛义夫·道莱本人，于12月24日破城大掠，缴获银币三十九万、骆驼两千。拜占庭虽未长期占领该城，哈姆丹王朝的军威却就此崩塌。福卡斯于次年八月即位，是为尼基弗鲁斯二世。
statement.en:
In December 962 the Byzantine Domestic of the Schools, Nikephoros Phokas, and his nephew John Tzimiskes launched a winter strike on Aleppo, the chief city of northern Syria. They routed the Hamdanid general Naja and then Emir Sayf al-Dawla himself, entering and sacking the city on 24 December and carrying off 390,000 silver coins and 2,000 camels. Byzantium did not hold the city permanently, but Hamdanid military prestige never recovered. Phokas was crowned Emperor Nikephoros II in August of the following year.

For Asia in 962 CE, “Byzantines sack Aleppo” is a traceable node of Military change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.en: Christianization of Silesia

summary.en: Holy Roman Emperor Otto I established a bishopric in Silesia on the border with Poland, forcing the local Slavic peoples to convert to Christianity. This was the first step in German eastward expansion.

statement.zh:
神圣罗马帝国皇帝奥托一世在波兰边境的西里西亚地区建立主教区，强迫当地斯拉夫人改信基督教。这是德国向东扩张的第一步。主教区以城堡与市场为据点，传教与移民同步推进；教会组织成为边疆治理的工具。宗教扩张与政治控制相互支持。

把「西里西亚地区基督教化」放回公元964年的波西米亚，可以看到宗教变化的一个具体切面。

title.en: Northern Song attacks Later Shu

summary.en: Emperor Taizu of Song sent three armies under Wang Quanbin, Cui Yanjin, and Liu Guangyi to attack Later Shu. The northern force advanced into Shu from Fengzhou, while the eastern force went up the Yangtze from Guizhou. Meng Chang, the ruler of Later Shu, was weak and incompetent, and his main forces collapsed at the first blow.

title.en: Abbasid caliph al-Muti ascends the throne

summary.en: In 964 CE, Abbasid caliph al-Muti ascended the throne in Baghdad. At this time, the Abbasid caliphs had become puppets of the Buwayhids. Al-Muti was in fact a puppet installed by the Buwayhid emir Bakhtiyar. The caliph's religious authority was still recognized, but his secular power had completely vanished.

title.en: Later Shu falls

summary.en: The Song army entered Chengdu, and Meng Chang, the last ruler of Later Shu, surrendered. He was escorted to Kaifeng, created Duke of Qin, and died mysteriously a few days later. Song Taizu transported the treasures of Later Shu to Kaifeng, filling the state treasury.

title.en: Fujiwara no Kaneie becomes Chancellor (Kampaku) in Japan

summary.en: In 965 CE (Kōhō 2), Fujiwara no Kaneie became Kampaku (regent). The Fujiwara clan wielded real power during the Heian period by marrying their daughters to emperors and acting as regents during the minority of the emperor. Fujiwara no Kaneie was the father of Fujiwara no Michinaga and paved the way for the Fujiwara's golden age.

statement.zh: 日本康保2年（公元965年），藤原兼家就任关白（摄政）。藤原氏在平安时代通过将女儿嫁给天皇并在天皇年幼时摄政掌握了实权。藤原兼家是藤原道长之父，为藤原氏全盛时期铺平了道路。
statement.en:
In 965 CE (Kōhō 2), Fujiwara no Kaneie became Kampaku (regent). The Fujiwara clan wielded real power during the Heian period by marrying their daughters to emperors and acting as regents during the minority of the emperor. Fujiwara no Kaneie was the father of Fujiwara no Michinaga and paved the way for the Fujiwara's golden age.

For Asia in 965 CE, “Fujiwara no Kaneie becomes Chancellor (Kampaku) in Japan” is a traceable node of Politics change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.en: King Bagrat III of Georgia dies

summary.en: Bagrat III, the founder of a unified Georgia, died, and was succeeded by his son George I. Georgia began to grow stronger, but soon afterward went to war with Byzantium.

statement.zh: 格鲁吉亚统一王国的奠基人巴格拉特三世去世，其子格奥尔基一世继位。格鲁吉亚开始走向强盛，但不久后与拜占庭发生战争。巴格拉特家族通过联姻与继承把阿布哈兹、陶与卡尔特利诸地并入一体，教会也归入统一管辖；继任者面对的是帝国东疆的压力与地方贵族的离心。
statement.en: Bagrat III, the founder of the United Kingdom of Georgia, died and was succeeded by his son Georgi I.

title.en: Sviatoslav destroys the Khazar khaganate

summary.en: In 965 Grand Prince Sviatoslav I of Kiev campaigned down the Don and the Volga, subduing the Vyatichi and the Volga Bulgars before storming the Khazar fortress of Sarkel on the Don and the capital Itil, then sacking Samandar on the Caspian shore. The Khazar khaganate - dominant on the Pontic steppe for over two centuries, wealthy on trade tolls and known for its Jewish ruling c

statement.zh: 965年，基辅罗斯大公斯维亚托斯拉夫一世沿顿河、伏尔加东征，先破维亚季奇人与伏尔加保加尔。继而攻陷可萨汗国扼守顿河的要塞萨克尔与都城伊蒂尔，又南下劫掠里海西岸的塞门德尔。称雄东欧草原两个多世纪、以商路税收与犹太教信仰著称的可萨汗国就此一蹶不振。罗斯人由是打通了通往里海与东方的商路，但草原上的屏障消失，佩切涅格人得以长驱直入，日后反成基辅之患。此后斯维亚托斯拉夫转兵多瑙河，于968年应拜占庭之邀征讨保加利亚。
statement.en: In 965 Grand Prince Sviatoslav I of Kiev campaigned down the Don and the Volga, subduing the Vyatichi and the Volga Bulgars before storming the Khazar fortress of Sarkel on the Don and the capital Itil, then sacking Samandar on the Caspian shore.

title.en: Mieszko I of Poland establishes an independent diocese

summary.en: Mieszko I, Duke of Poland, requested the establishment of a bishopric at Poznań, directly under the pope, to free himself from German ecclesiastical control. This step strengthened the independence of the Polish church.

statement.zh:
波兰公爵梅什科一世请求在波兹南设立主教区，直接隶属于教皇，以摆脱德意志主教的控制。这一举措加强了波兰教会的独立性。直属教廷使波兰教会避开帝国教会体系，主教任命与传教由王室主导；教会独立也服务于新兴国家的政治自主。宗教组织成为主权的一部分。

把「波兰梅什科一世建立独立教区」放回公元966年的波兰，可以看到宗教变化的一个具体切面。

title.en: Emperor Taizu of Song perfects the civil service examination system

summary.en: Emperor Taizu of Song formally established the triennial examination system and created the "palace examination," personally presiding over the final test. He also ordered the adoption of name-blanketing ( name-blanking , huming) to prevent examiner fraud. The improvement of the examination system brought a large number of scholars from humble backgrounds into the bureaucracy.

title.en: Byzantine Emperor Nikephoros II Phokas is assassinated

summary.en: Empress Theophano and her lover John Tzimiskes conspired to assassinate Emperor Nikephoros II in the palace. John succeeded him as emperor (John I).

title.en: Sviatoslav's First Bulgarian Campaign; Pechenegs Besiege Kiev

summary.en: Unwilling to keep paying tribute to Bulgaria, Emperor Nikephoros II sent the envoy Kalokyros north with gold to set Sviatoslav of Kiev on the Bulgarians. statement.zh: 拜占庭皇帝尼基弗鲁斯二世不愿再向保加利亚缴纳岁币，遣使者卡洛基罗斯携黄金北上，怂恿基辅大公斯维亚托斯拉夫代为出兵。968年斯氏率军渡多瑙河，连破保加利亚沙皇彼得一世之师，占多瑙河下游八十余城，并萌生弃基辅而都佩列亚斯拉维茨之念。同年佩切涅格人乘虚南下围困基辅，年迈的奥尔加与三个孙儿困守孤城，粮水断绝，赖一少年泅渡第聂伯河向对岸部队求援、诈称大公将至，游牧骑兵方退。斯维亚托斯拉夫闻讯驰归，其母责之曰：「汝觅他乡而弃故土。」。
statement.en:
Unwilling to keep paying tribute to Bulgaria, Emperor Nikephoros II sent the envoy Kalokyros north with gold to set Sviatoslav of Kiev on the Bulgarians. In 968 Sviatoslav crossed the Danube, broke the armies of Tsar Peter I, took some eighty towns along the lower river, and conceived the idea of abandoning Kiev for Pereyaslavets. That same year the Pechenegs exploited his absence to besiege Kiev, where the aged Olga and three grandsons were trapped without food or water until a youth swam the Dnieper to the troops on the far bank and bluffed that the prince was coming, whereupon the nomads withdrew. Sviatoslav rode home at the news, and his mother reproached him: 'you seek a foreign land and abandon your own.'

title.en: Northern Song begins campaigns against Northern Han

summary.en: Emperor Taizu of Song personally led a campaign against Northern Han, besieging Taiyuan. But Khitan reinforcements arrived, and the Song forces ran short of supplies, forcing a withdrawal. Northern Han continued to survive under Khitan protection.

statement.zh:
宋太祖赵匡胤亲征北汉，围困太原。但因契丹援军赶到，宋军粮草不继，被迫撤退。北汉在契丹保护下继续存在。围攻以筑垒与断援为主，宋军未能阻断契丹的骑兵增援，雨季与补给问题又加剧困难；撤军之后，北汉仍依辽自守。

title.en: The Sanjūrokkasen (Thirty-six Poets) anthology is compiled in Japan

summary.en: In 969 CE (Anna 2), the anthology Sanjūrokkasen (Thirty-six Poets) was compiled. title.en: Liao Muzong is killed; Jingzong succeeds

title.en: Islamic scholar al-Farabi dies

summary.en: The Persian philosopher al-Farabi died in Baghdad. He was one of the most outstanding philosophers of the Islamic Golden Age, known as the "Second Teacher" (after Aristotle).

title.en: Mieszko I of Poland conquers Pomerania

title.en: Northern Song destroys Southern Han

summary.en: Emperor Taizu of Song sent Pan Mei south to attack Southern Han. The Song army captured Guangzhou, and Southern Han emperor Liu Chang surrendered. He was taken to Kaifeng, and Southern Han fell. The Northern Song gained sixty prefectures in Lingnan.

statement.zh:
宋太祖派潘美率军南征南汉。宋军攻破广州，南汉后主刘鋹投降。刘鋹被押送开封，南汉亡。北宋获得岭南六十州。南征以水路与陆路并进，绕过险要直取都城；南汉的降附使北宋取得岭南的港口与财赋。

把「北宋灭南汉」放回公元970年的北宋，可以看到军事变化的一个具体切面。

title.en: Christianization of Scandinavia accelerates

summary.en: King Harald Bluetooth of Denmark had a runestone carved at Jelling, inscribed with his claim to have "made the Danes Christian." King Olaf I of Norway also used violence to promote Christianity. Christianity spread rapidly in Northern Europe.

title.en: Al-Azhar University is founded at Al-Azhar Mosque in Cairo

summary.en: The Fatimid dynasty formally established a university curriculum at the Al-Azhar Mosque, teaching theology, jurisprudence, grammar, and astronomy. It is considered one of the world's earliest universities.

title.en: Northern Song consolidates Lingnan, implements pacification policies

summary.en: After destroying Southern Han, Emperor Taizu of Song issued a three-year tax exemption, freed slaves, and sent civilian officials to govern Lingnan. The region stabilized, and the Song gained control of the gateway to South China Sea trade.

statement.zh: 灭南汉后，宋太祖推行免赋三年、释放奴婢的政策，并派遣文官治理岭南。岭南局势逐渐稳定，宋朝控制了南海贸易的咽喉。宋廷以轻徭薄赋安抚地方，招抚俚僚诸族，同时设市舶管理海上商税；文官取代武将在地方施政，使岭南由割据之地转为帝国财源。政策兼顾稳定与收益。

title.en: Sviatoslav Slain at the Dnieper Rapids

summary.en: In March 970 the Byzantine commander Bardas Skleros routed a coalition of Rus', Pechenegs, Magyars and Bulgarians at Arcadiopolis in Thrace by means of a feigned retreat and ambush. The next year John I Tzimiskes campaigned in person, took the Bulgarian capital Preslav, and penned Sviatoslav in Dorostolon on the Danube for sixty-five days. Starved out, Sviatoslav met the empero

statement.zh: 970年3月，拜占庭统帅巴尔达斯·斯克莱罗斯在色雷斯的阿卡迪波利斯以佯退设伏，击溃罗斯、佩切涅格、马扎尔与保加利亚联军。
statement.en: In March 970 the Byzantine commander Bardas Skleros routed a coalition of Rus', Pechenegs, Magyars and Bulgarians at Arcadiopolis in Thrace by means of a feigned retreat and ambush.

zh: 970年3月，拜占庭统帅巴尔达斯·斯克莱罗斯在色雷斯的阿卡迪波利斯以佯退设伏，击溃罗斯、佩切涅格、马扎尔与保加利亚联军。
en: In March 970 the Byzantine commander Bardas Skleros routed a coalition of Rus', Pechenegs, Magyars and Bulgarians at Arcadiopolis in Thrace by means of a feigned retreat and ambush.

statement.zh: 翌年约翰一世·齐米斯基斯亲征，破保加利亚都城普雷斯拉夫，将斯维亚托斯拉夫围于多瑙河畔的多罗斯托隆达六十五日。
statement.en: The next year John I Tzimiskes campaigned in person, took the Bulgarian capital Preslav, and penned Sviatoslav in Dorostolon on the Danube for 65 days.

zh: 翌年约翰一世·齐米斯基斯亲征，破保加利亚都城普雷斯拉夫，将斯维亚托斯拉夫围于多瑙河畔的多罗斯托隆达六十五日。
en: The next year John I Tzimiskes campaigned in person, took the Bulgarian capital Preslav, and penned Sviatoslav in Dorostolon on the Danube for 65 days.

note.zh: 数字表述统一；事实待来源核验

statement.zh: 粮尽援绝，斯氏与皇帝会于河上小舟议和：罗斯撤出巴尔干、放弃克里米亚南部权利，拜占庭则供给粮秣并许其安然返国。
statement.en: Starved out, Sviatoslav met the emperor in a boat on the river and agreed to quit the Balkans and renounce his claims in the southern Crimea in return for provisions and safe passage.

title.en: Otto II succeeds as Holy Roman Emperor

summary.en: Otto I died, and his son Otto II succeeded. He married the Byzantine princess Theophanu, strengthening ties with Byzantium. He continued to suppress rebellious nobles in Germany.

statement.zh:
奥托一世去世，其子奥托二世继位。奥托二世娶拜占庭公主狄奥法诺为后，加强了与拜占庭的联系。他继续镇压国内叛乱贵族。婚姻把西方的皇权与东方的宫廷连在一起，意大利的政策与帝位观念随之调整；诸侯的叛乱考验着新君。帝国的重心仍在意德之间。

把「奥托二世继任神圣罗马帝国皇帝」放回公元972年的神圣罗马帝国，可以看到政治变化的一个具体切面。

title.en: Fujiwara no Michitaka becomes Chancellor (Kampaku) in Japan

summary.en: In 972 CE (Tenroku 3), Fujiwara no Michitaka became Kampaku (chancellor). He was the son of Fujiwara no Kaneie and older brother of Fujiwara no Michinaga. During his tenure, the Fujiwara regency continued, but fierce power struggles within the family (Michitaka vs. Michinaga) continued.

statement.zh: 日本天禄3年（公元972年），藤原道隆就任关白。他是藤原兼家之子，藤原道长的兄长。藤原道隆在任期间延续了藤原氏的摄关政治，但其家族内部（道隆与道长）权力斗争激烈。

title.en: Northern Song reorganizes the imperial guard; implements the rotating garrison system

summary.en: Emperor Taizu of Song introduced the rotating garrison system (gengshu fa), requiring imperial guard units to change their garrison posts regularly, but their commanders did not move with them, achieving the principle that "the soldiers do not recognize their generals, and the generals do not command the soldiers." This prevented the emergence of warlords.

title.en: Zhao Kuangyin and Zhao Pu formulate policy on a snowy night

summary.en: Emperor Taizu of Song visited his chancellor Zhao Pu on a snowy night to discuss a unification strategy. Zhao Pu proposed the "south first, then north" strategy: first pacify the southern kingdoms, then recover the Sixteen Prefectures of Yanyun. The emperor adopted this plan, accelerating unification.

title.en: Đinh Bộ Lĩnh proclaims himself emperor, founding the Đinh dynasty in Vietnam

summary.en: The Vietnamese local warlord Đinh Bộ Lĩnh, having pacified the Twelve Warlords, proclaimed himself Emperor Đại Thắng Minh, with the dynastic name Đại Cồ Việt, and made his capital at Hoa Lư (present-day Ninh Bình). This was the first independent dynasty in Vietnamese history, breaking away from China.

title.en: Caliph Hisham II of Córdoba ascends the throne

summary.en: Caliph Hakam II of Córdoba died, and his son Hisham II succeeded at the age of ten. The chief minister (hajib) al-Mansur seized actual power, becoming the de facto ruler of the Caliphate of Córdoba.

statement.zh: 科尔多瓦哈里发哈卡姆二世去世，其子希沙姆二世继位，年仅十岁。侍从长阿尔曼苏尔掌握实权，成为后倭马亚的实际统治者。少年哈里发被隔离于宫廷礼仪之中，军政与财赋由侍从长及其家族节制；他多次北征基督教王国，以战利品与威望巩固权位，哈里发的名义权威与实际权力由此分离。

title.en: Northern Song attacks Southern Tang

summary.en: Using as a pretext that Li Yu, the ruler of Southern Tang, had claimed to be ill and not appeared at court, Emperor Taizu of Song sent Cao Bin and Pan Mei with 100,000 troops south. The Song army built pontoon bridges to cross the Yangtze and advanced directly on Jinling. The Southern Tang army was routed.

statement.zh:
宋太祖以南唐后主李煜称疾不朝为由，派曹彬、潘美率十万大军南征。宋军造浮桥渡过长江，直逼金陵。南唐军溃败。浮桥解决了大军渡江的难题，使宋军得以保持攻势；南唐依赖长江天险与水军，指挥与士气不足。金陵受围后，南唐的抵抗迅速瓦解。

把「北宋攻南唐」放回公元974年的北宋，可以看到军事变化的一个具体切面。

title.en: Emperor Taizu of Song reforms taxation and standardizes weights and measures

summary.en: After unifying the south, Emperor Taizu ordered the nationwide standardization of weights and measures and introduced a system of leasing state lands to tenant farmers, distributing large amounts of waste land to landless peasants. The Song economy began to recover.

statement.zh: 北宋统一南方后，宋太祖下令全国统一度量衡，并推行“官田招佃”制度，将大量荒地分给无地农民。北宋经济开始复苏。统一度量衡便利跨区域征税与贸易，招佃把国有荒地转为可耕之地，租佃关系由此扩展；财政与农业在同一套制度下恢复。国家能力借助标准化而增强。
statement.en: After the Northern Song Dynasty unified the south, Song Taizu ordered the country to unify weights and measures, and implemented the "official land recruiting tenants" system to allocate large amounts of wasteland to landless farmers.

title.en: Southern Tang falls; Li Yu is captured

summary.en: Cao Bin stormed Jinling, and Li Yu, the last ruler of Southern Tang, surrendered. He was taken to Kaifeng and given the mocking title "Marquis Who Violated Orders." Southern Tang fell. Li Yu was a famous poet, and his ci lyrics remain immortal. The Northern Song had basically unified the south.
