title.en: Gwangjong of Goryeo dies; Gyeongjong ascends the throne

summary.en: King Gwangjong of Goryeo died after twenty-six years on the throne and was succeeded by his son Wang Ju, King Gyeongjong. Gwangjong had greatly strengthened royal authority through the Slave Review Act, the civil examinations and the graded official robes, but grew ever more suspicious in his later years, encouraged denunciations and executed large numbers of merit officials, s

statement.zh: 在位26年的高丽光宗王昭去世，子王伷继位，是为景宗。光宗以奴婢按检法、科举与百官公服诸制强化王权，成效卓著，然晚年猜忌日深，大兴告讦之风，诛戮功臣宿将与宗室甚众。连惠宗、定宗之子亦不能免，朝野惴恐，狱中冤死者不可胜数。景宗即位后大赦被诬者、许其子弟复仇，一时私斗横行、滥杀又起，不得已再下令严禁；次年颁行田柴科，以国家授田安抚官僚集团，朝局始定。
statement.en: King Gwangjong of Goryeo died after 26 years on the throne and was succeeded by his son Wang Ju, King Gyeongjong. Gwangjong had greatly strengthened royal authority through the Slave Review Act, the civil examinations and the graded official robes, but grew ever more suspicious in his later years, encouraged denunciations and executed large numbers of merit officials. Senior generals and royal kinsmen — not sparing the sons of Hyejong and Jeongjong — until the court lived in terror and countless men died in prison. On his accession Gyeongjong pardoned those falsely accused and allowed their kin to take revenge, which unleashed such a wave of private killing that he was forced to ban it again; the following year he promulgated the Jeonsigwa land system, pacifying the bureaucracy with state-granted land and steadying the court.

zh: 在位26年的高丽光宗王昭去世，子王伷继位，是为景宗。光宗以奴婢按检法、科举与百官公服诸制强化王权，成效卓著，然晚年猜忌日深，大兴告讦之风，诛戮功臣宿将与宗室甚众。连惠宗、定宗之子亦不能免，朝野惴恐，狱中冤死者不可胜数。景宗即位后大赦被诬者、许其子弟复仇，一时私斗横行、滥杀又起，不得已再下令严禁；次年颁行田柴科，以国家授田安抚官僚集团，朝局始定。
en: King Gwangjong of Goryeo died after 26 years on the throne and was succeeded by his son Wang Ju, King Gyeongjong. Gwangjong had greatly strengthened royal authority through the Slave Review Act, the civil examinations and the graded official robes, but grew ever more suspicious in his later years, encouraged denunciations and executed large numbers of merit officials. Senior generals and royal kinsmen — not sparing the sons of Hyejong and Jeongjong — until the court lived in terror and countless men died in prison. On his accession Gyeongjong pardoned those falsely accused and allowed their kin to take revenge, which unleashed such a wave of private killing that he was forced to ban it again; the following year he promulgated the Jeonsigwa land system, pacifying the bureaucracy with state-granted land and steadying the court.

title.en: Byzantine Emperor John I dies

summary.en: In January 976 the Byzantine emperor John I Tzimiskes died on his way back from campaigning in Syria. A key ruler of the Macedonian period, during his reign (969-976) he defeated the Bulgarians and Sviatoslav's Rus' and pushed east into Syria, expanding the empire in the Balkans and the Near East. His death brought Basil II to personal rule.

title.en: Đinh Bộ Lĩnh sends envoys to the Song court

summary.en: In 976 CE, after Đinh Bộ Lĩnh (Đinh Tiên Hoàng) had unified Vietnam, he sent envoys to the Northern Song to pay tribute and requested recognition from Emperor Taizu. Đinh Bộ Lĩnh was the first Vietnamese emperor to centralize power. The Song recognized Đinh's independence, investing him as King of Jiaozhi.

title.en: Otto II invades Italy

summary.en: Holy Roman Emperor Otto II led his army across the Alps to suppress a rebellion of northern Italian nobles, reestablishing imperial suzerainty over Italy.

zh: 高丽景宗元年十一月，始定职散官各品田柴科：按人品与官阶高下，授予田地（收租之地）与柴地（薪炭山林）。
en: In the eleventh month of the first year of King Gyeongjong, Goryeo first fixed the Jeonsigwa, allocating to officials of every grade, active and reserve, both jeon (land whose rent they collected) and si (woodland for fuel), graded by personal standing and office rank; on the holder's death the grant reverted to the state and could not be inherited.

title.en: Chen Hongjin submits to the Song

summary.en: Chen Hongjin, who controlled Quanzhou (Qingyuan Military Command), surrendered the two prefectures of Zhang and Quanzhou to the Song. Emperor Taizong appointed him military commissioner of Wuning. Southern Fujian was completely incorporated into the Northern Song.

statement.zh:
割据泉州的陈洪进（清源军节度使）献出漳州、泉州两州，归顺北宋。宋太宗授予其武宁军节度使。闽南彻底并入北宋。纳土以保全家族与地方利益为条件，换得名号与安置；泉漳的港口与海外贸易由此纳入宋朝体系。割据的终结扩大了北宋的东南财源。

把「陈洪进纳土归宋」放回公元977年的北宋，可以看到政治变化的一个具体切面。

title.en: The Utsuho Monogatari is written in Japan

summary.en: Around 977 CE (Jōgen 2), the Utsuho Monogatari (The Tale of the Hollow Tree) was begun. This work is one of the earliest "long monogatari" in Japan, focusing on the love lives of several aristocratic men and women in a court setting. It has a complex structure and is quite lengthy.

statement.zh: 日本贞元2年（公元977年）左右，《宇津保物语》（宇津保物语）开始创作。该作品是日本最早的"长编物语"之一，以宫廷为背景讲述了多位贵族男女的爱情故事。作品结构复杂，篇幅较长。
statement.en:

For Asia in 977 CE, “The Utsuho Monogatari is written in Japan” is a traceable node of Literature change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.en: Wuyue submits to the Song

summary.en: King Qian Chu of Wuyue surrendered his thirteen prefectures to the Song. Qian Chu personally went to Kaifeng to pay court, and Emperor Taizong detained him there, granting him estates for his retirement. Wuyue fell, leaving only Northern Han among the Ten Kingdoms.

statement.zh:
吴越国王钱俶献出十三州土地归顺北宋。钱俶亲自到开封朝觐，宋太宗将其留下，赐地养老。吴越灭亡，十国只剩下北汉。纳土把两浙的财赋与海港完整移交，减少战火破坏；王室北上后的待遇成为安抚降附的示范。两浙由此免于兵燹。

title.en: Harald Bluetooth of Denmark erects the Jelling Stones

summary.en: King Harald Bluetooth of Denmark erected the Jelling Stones, a set of three runestones, one of which depicts Christ and bears an Old Norse inscription recording his unification of Denmark and his conversion to Christianity. The Jelling Stones have been called "Denmark's birth certificate."

statement.zh: 丹麦国王蓝牙哈拉尔德在耶灵建造三面石碑，其中一面刻有基督像和古北欧文，记载他统一丹麦并皈依基督教的功绩。耶灵石碑被称为“丹麦的出生证明”。石碑以王室纪念碑的形式宣示王权与信仰的转向，符文与图像并置；耶灵的王室墓地与教堂同处一地，见证王朝的建立。

title.en: Battle of Gaoliang River: Emperor Taizong of Song suffers a crushing defeat in his northern campaign

summary.en: Taking advantage of the momentum of destroying Northern Han, Emperor Taizong of Song led his army north against the Khitans in an attempt to recover the Sixteen Prefectures of Yanyun. statement.zh: 宋太宗乘灭北汉之势，率军北伐契丹，试图收复燕云十六州。宋军围攻幽州（今北京），契丹名将耶律休哥率援军反攻，在高梁河（今北京西直门外）大败宋军。太宗身中数箭，乘驴车南逃。此战宋军伤亡惨重，北伐失败。
statement.en:
Taking advantage of the momentum of destroying Northern Han, Emperor Taizong of Song led his army north against the Khitans in an attempt to recover the Sixteen Prefectures of Yanyun. The Song army besieged Youzhou (modern Beijing). The Khitan general Yelü Xiuge led reinforcements to the rescue and decisively defeated the Song army on the Gaoliang River (northwest of present-day Beijing). The emperor was wounded by arrows and fled south on a donkey cart. The Song army suffered heavy losses, and the northern campaign failed.

For Asia in 979 CE, “Battle of Gaoliang River: Emperor Taizong of Song suffers a crushing defeat in his northern campaign” is a traceable node of Military change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.en: Mahmud of Ghazni ascends the throne

summary.en: Mahmud succeeded as Sultan of the Ghaznavid dynasty. He turned Ghazni into a powerful military empire in Central Asia, launching multiple invasions of India and plundering the treasures of the northern Indian princes.

title.en: King Olaf I of Norway is killed in battle

summary.en: King Olaf I of Norway was defeated in a naval battle against a Danish–Swedish coalition and drowned himself. Norway was annexed by Denmark and did not regain independence until 1015.

statement.zh: 挪威国王奥拉夫一世在与丹麦、瑞典联军的海战中战败，跳海身亡。挪威被丹麦吞并，直到1015年才重获独立。海战决定性地削弱了挪威的王权，丹麦借机把宗主权推向挪威；此后挪威由丹麦王室委任的领主治理，地方贵族在夹缝中维持影响。1015年成为其政治记忆的转折点。
statement.en: King Olav I of Norway was defeated in a naval battle with the Danish and Swedish coalition forces and jumped into the sea to his death.

title.en: Northern Song destroys Northern Han, basically reunifies China

summary.en: The Song army stormed Taiyuan, and the Northern Han emperor Liu Jiyuan surrendered. Northern Han fell. title.en: Avicenna is born

summary.en: The Persian polymath Ibn Sina (Avicenna, 980-1037) mastered medicine young and wrote the 'Canon of Medicine', summing up Greek and Islamic medical learning and shaping European medicine for centuries.

statement.zh:
波斯全才学者伊本·西纳（阿维森纳，980—1037）幼年通医，著《医典》集古希腊与伊斯兰医学之大成，影响欧洲医界数百年。他把哲学、医学与自然研究贯通，医典以系统编排整理理论与临床；译本进入欧洲大学。知识的跨文化传递由此实现。

把「伊本·西纳（阿维森纳）出生」放回公元980年的中亚，可以看到科学变化的一个具体切面。
statement.en: The versatile Persian scholar Ibn Sina (Avicenna, 980-1037) was a master of medicine at a young age.

title.en: Emperor Jingzong of Liao invades the south; fierce fighting on the Song-Liao border

summary.en: Emperor Jingzong of Liao led his army south to attack Waqiao Pass (present-day Xiong County, Hebei). The Song generals Zhang Qixian and Tian Chongjin commanded the resistance, and the two sides fought a tug-of-war along the border. The Liao army looted and then withdrew.

statement.zh:
辽景宗耶律贤率军南下，攻打瓦桥关（今河北雄县）。宋将张齐贤、田重进等率军迎战，双方在边境拉锯，辽军劫掠后撤退。关口与塘泊是双方角力的焦点，骑军快速突入而宋军据险坚守；边境的堡寨与乡民在战事中反复受损。对峙未改边界的走向。

把「辽景宗南侵，宋辽边境激战」放回公元980年的北宋，可以看到军事变化的一个具体切面。

title.en: King Æthelred II of England ascends the throne

summary.en: Æthelred II the Unready became king of England. During his reign, Danish Vikings invaded in force, and England was forced to pay large sums of Danegeld to buy peace.

statement.zh:
英国国王埃塞尔雷德二世（决策无方者）继位。他在位期间丹麦维京人大举入侵，英国被迫缴纳巨额丹麦金求和。统治初期面对斯堪的纳维亚的袭扰，王室以征税纳贡换取停战，财政与权威都受削弱；地方防务依赖贵族征召。其称号与施政成为后世议论的对象。

把「英国埃塞尔雷德二世继位」放回公元980年的英格兰，可以看到政治变化的一个具体切面。

title.en: The historical work Ōkagami is compiled in Japan

summary.en: Japanese nobles compiled the historical Ōkagami (Great Mirror), written in a question-and-answer style, relating events from Emperor Montoku to Emperor Go-Ichijō. This work is among the "four mirrors" of Japanese historiography and preserves Heian court records.

statement.zh:
日本贵族编纂历史著作《大镜》，采用问答体形式，叙述从文德天皇到后一条天皇的史实。该书是“四镜”之一，保留了平安时代宫廷的记录。问答体把史实与评断并置，借对话讨论治乱与人物；宫廷记忆由此整理成书。史学与文学在文本中结合。

title.en: Emperor Taizong of Song orders the compilation of the Taiping Yulan

summary.en: Emperor Taizong commissioned Li Fang and others to compile the massive encyclopedia Taiping Yulan (Imperial Readings of the Taiping Era), in 1,000 volumes and 55 sections, drawing from classics, histories, philosophers, and literature. The work took six years and became a monumental Song-dynasty encyclopedia.

statement.zh: 宋太宗命李昉等编纂大型类书《太平御览》，全书一千卷，分五十五部，取材于经史子集各类书籍。该书历时六年编成，成为宋代百科全书式的巨著。编纂以分类摘录为法，把散见的典故、制度与诗文汇于一处，便于检索与征引；卷帙之巨反映北宋初年文献的汇聚。类书成为士人治学的工具。
statement.en: Emperor Taizong of the Song Dynasty ordered Li Fang and others to compile a large-scale book called "Taiping Yulan", which consists of one thousand volumes and is divided into fifty-five parts.

title.en: Northern Song builds fortifications at Dingzhou and Zhenzhou

summary.en: To defend against the Khitans, the Song built city walls at Dingzhou, Zhenzhou, and other places, stockpiled provisions, and stationed heavy troops. The border generals Li Jilong and Tian Chongjin vigorously trained their troops.

statement.zh:
为防御契丹，北宋在定州、镇州等地修筑城池，囤积粮草，驻守重兵。边防将领李继隆、田重进等积极操练军队。城防以城墙、壕沟与堡寨构成纵深，粮草沿官道转运；将领整训部队，以备骑兵南下。河北防线由此成为宋初北边的重要屏障。

把「北宋修筑定州、镇州城防」放回公元981年的北宋，可以看到军事变化的一个具体切面。

title.en: Byzantine Basil II suppresses a rebellion in Asia Minor

summary.en: Byzantine Emperor Basil II (then twenty-three years old) led an army to suppress a rebellion of the Anatolian nobility. He confiscated the rebels' lands and distributed them to commoner soldiers, laying the foundation for a military power base.

statement.zh: 拜占庭皇帝巴西尔二世（时年23岁）率军镇压小亚细亚的贵族叛乱。他没收叛军土地，将其分给平民士兵，奠定了军事强权的基础。
statement.en:
Byzantine Emperor Basil II (then 23 years old) led an army to suppress a rebellion of the Anatolian nobility. He confiscated the rebels' lands and distributed them to commoner soldiers, laying the foundation for a military power base.

title.en: Erik the Red discovers Greenland

summary.en: The Norwegian explorer Erik Thorvaldsson (Erik the Red), exiled from Iceland for murder, sailed west and discovered a large ice-covered land, which he named Greenland ("green land"). Three years later he led settlers there to establish a colony.

statement.zh: 挪威探险家红发埃里克因杀人被冰岛流放。他向西航行，发现了一片冰雪覆盖的大陆，命名为“格陵兰”（绿色之地）。三年后他带领移民在此定居。命名以宜居之名吸引移民，航路与季节决定殖民成败；冰岛与格陵兰之间形成北大西洋航线。北欧人的海洋扩张由此延伸。
statement.en: The Norwegian explorer Erik the Red was exiled from Iceland for murder.

title.en: Emperor Jingzong of Liao dies; Emperor Shengzong succeeds

summary.en: Emperor Jingzong of Liao died of illness and was succeeded by his son Yelü Longxu, who was only twelve, becoming Emperor Shengzong. Empress Dowager Xiao Chuo acted as regent. She promoted the Han Chinese official Han Derang and carried out reforms, ushering in the peak period of the Liao dynasty.

statement.zh: 辽景宗耶律贤病逝，其子耶律隆绪继位，年仅十二岁，是为辽圣宗。皇太后萧绰摄政，她重用汉臣韩德让，推行改革，辽朝进入鼎盛期。
statement.en:
Emperor Jingzong of Liao died of illness and was succeeded by his son Yelü Longxu, who was only twelve, becoming Emperor Shengzong. Empress Dowager Xiao Chuo acted as regent. She promoted the Han Chinese official Han Derang and carried out reforms, ushering in the peak period of the Liao dynasty.

For Asia in 982 CE, “Emperor Jingzong of Liao dies; Emperor Shengzong succeeds” is a traceable node of Politics change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.en: Li Jiqian rebels against the Song; precursor of Western Xia rises

summary.en: Li Jiqian, chief of the Tangut tribe, rebelled against the Song because the Song had taken back the territory of Xiazhou. He fled with his followers to Dijinze (present-day Inner Mongolia) and married a Khitan princess, receiving Liao recognition. The independence of Western Xia began at this time.

title.en: Liao changes reign title to Tonghe; Empress Dowager Xiao Chuo acts as regent

summary.en: Emperor Shengzong of Liao changed the reign title to Tonghe, and Empress Dowager Xiao Chuo formally assumed regency. She ordered tax reductions, streamlined administration, and personally led armies south against the Song, beginning a new phase of the Song-Liao war.

statement.zh:
辽圣宗改年号为统和，萧太后正式临朝称制。她下令减免赋税，整顿吏治，并亲自率军南征北宋，开启宋辽战争的新阶段。摄政以母后权威统合契丹贵族与汉地官僚，赋税与吏治改革稳定内部；南征把内部整合转化为对外压力。宋辽对峙由此进入新阶段。

把「辽改元统和，萧太后摄政」放回公元983年的辽，可以看到政治变化的一个具体切面。

title.en: Fatimids build desert palaces

title.en: Venice obtains commercial privileges from Byzantium

summary.en: In return for Venetian naval support, Byzantine Emperor Basil II granted Venetian merchants duty-free trading privileges in Constantinople. Venice began to dominate eastern Mediterranean trade.

statement.zh:
拜占庭皇帝巴西尔二世为换取威尼斯海军支援，授予威尼斯商人在君士坦丁堡免税贸易的特权。威尼斯开始垄断东地中海贸易。特权以海上援助换取商业利益，免税与港口便利使威尼斯商人占得先机；商业优势又反哺海军与城邦财政。东地中海的贸易格局因此倾斜。

title.en: King Seongjong of Goryeo promotes Confucian rule

summary.en: King Seongjong of Goryeo (r. 981–997) formally promoted a Confucian governing policy in 983. He established a National University (Gukjagam), introduced the Chinese civil service examination system to select officials, and promoted the Confucian classics. Seongjong's reforms had a profound impact on Goryeo's political system and the spread of Confucian culture in Korea.

statement.zh: 高丽成宗（公元981-997年在位）于983年正式推行儒教治国政策。他设立了国子监（太学），引进中国的科举制度选拔官员，推崇儒家经典。成宗的改革对高丽政治制度和儒家文化在朝鲜半岛的传播产生了深远影响。

title.en: Emperor Taizong of Song changes reign title to Yongxi

summary.en: In the ninth year of the Taiping Xingguo era (984 CE), Emperor Taizong of Song changed the reign title to Yongxi. During the Yongxi era (984–987), the Song continued its unification campaigns. In 985, the Song launched the Yongxi Northern Campaign against the Liao, hoping to recover the Sixteen Prefectures of Yanyun, but it ended in a disastrous defeat at the Battle of Gaoliang

statement.zh: 宋太平兴国九年（公元984年），宋太宗赵光义改年号为"雍熙"。雍熙年间（984-987年）北宋继续推进统一战争。985年北宋发动对辽国的雍熙北伐，以期收复燕云十六州。但北伐在高粱河战役中遭遇惨败。
statement.en:
In the ninth year of the Taiping Xingguo era (984 CE), Emperor Taizong of Song changed the reign title to Yongxi. During the Yongxi era (984–987), the Song continued its unification campaigns. In 985, the Song launched the Yongxi Northern Campaign against the Liao, hoping to recover the Sixteen Prefectures of Yanyun, but it ended in a disastrous defeat at the Battle of Gaoliang River.

title.en: Chola Empire begins to expand

summary.en: Rajaraja I, king of the Chola dynasty in South India, ascended the throne. He built a powerful navy and began expanding into Sri Lanka and the Maldives, marking the start of the Chola Empire's peak.

statement.zh:
南印度朱罗国王罗阇罗阇一世继位。他组建强大的海军，开始向斯里兰卡和马尔代夫扩张，标志着朱罗帝国进入鼎盛期。海权支撑跨海远征与贸易，港口与商路带来财富；王权借军事与宗教建筑树立权威。南印度的海上力量由此影响印度洋贸易格局。

把「朱罗帝国开始扩张」放回公元985年的朱罗帝国，可以看到政治变化的一个具体切面。

title.en: Li Jiqian submits to the Liao

summary.en: In 985 CE, the Tangut chief Li Jiqian, to oppose the Northern Song's military pressure, surrendered to the Liao. title.en: Battle of Qigou Pass: the Song army is routed

summary.en: The Song's three-pronged northern campaign met the main Khitan army at Qigou Pass (present-day Zhuozhou, Hebei). Empress Dowager Xiao Chuo led the Khitan army in person; Yelü Xiuge cut off the Song's supply lines. The eastern force under Cao Bin collapsed, suffering tens of thousands of casualties. Emperor Taizong ordered a general retreat.

title.en: Yang Ye is captured and starves himself to death

summary.en: The Song general Yang Ye (Yang Jive), while covering the retreat of civilians, was surrounded by Khitan forces at Chenjia Valley. Wounded and captured, he died after fasting for three days. He is the prototype of the legendary "Yang family generals."

statement.zh: 宋将杨业（杨继业）掩护百姓撤退，在陈家谷口被契丹军包围。杨业受伤被俘，绝食三日而死。他是后世“杨家将”传说的原型。
statement.en:
The Song general Yang Ye (Yang Jive), while covering the retreat of civilians, was surrounded by Khitan forces at Chenjia Valley. Wounded and captured, he died after fasting for three days. He is the prototype of the legendary "Yang family generals."

For Asia in 986 CE, “Yang Ye is captured and starves himself to death” is a traceable node of Military change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.en: The Eiga Monogatari is compiled in Japan

summary.en: The Japanese noblewoman Akazome Emon began writing the Eiga Monogatari (Tale of Flowering Fortunes), recording the rise of Fujiwara no Michinaga's family. It is the first historical work written by a Japanese noblewoman.

statement.zh:
日本贵族女性赤染卫门开始撰写《荣华物语》，记录藤原道长一族的繁盛。以贵族女性的视角书写摄关家族的兴衰，使这部作品既接近史书，又带有宫廷生活的细节；它因此被视为日本第一部贵族女性创作的史书。作者身份与记述对象共同决定了它的史料价值。

把「日本《荣华物语》编纂」放回公元986年的日本，可以看到文学变化的一个具体切面。

title.en: Byzantines conquer Bulgaria

summary.en: Byzantine Emperor Basil II launched a large-scale war against Bulgaria, capturing northern Bulgarian fortresses. Tsar Samuel of Bulgaria was forced to withdraw to the mountains.

statement.zh:
拜占庭皇帝巴西尔二世发动对保加利亚的大规模战争，攻占保加利亚北部要塞。保加利亚沙皇萨穆埃尔被迫退守山区。战争以要塞攻坚与长期消耗推进，拜占庭恢复多瑙河一线的控制；保加利亚的抵抗转入山地。巴尔干的力量对比逐渐倾向拜占庭。

把「拜占庭征服保加利亚」放回公元986年的拜占庭帝国，可以看到军事变化的一个具体切面。
statement.en: Byzantine Emperor Basil II launched a large-scale war against Bulgaria and captured the northern Bulgarian fortress.

title.en: Northern Song shifts to strategic defense against Liao

summary.en: After the disastrous defeat at Qigou Pass, Emperor Taizong abandoned northern campaigns and instead fortified the border. He ordered border commanders not to provoke the Khitans and built up the military strongholds of Dingzhou and Zhenzhou. The Song and Liao entered a stalemate.

statement.zh: 岐沟关惨败后，宋太宗放弃北伐，转为沿边设防。他下诏禁止边将挑衅辽朝，修筑定州、真定等军事重镇。宋辽进入相持阶段。防线以城池、塘泊与屯田相互支撑，边将的主动权被收归朝廷；以守代攻的策略减少了大规模野战，却也使恢复失地愈发遥远。此后议和之论渐起。
statement.en: After the disastrous defeat at Qigou Pass, Emperor Taizong abandoned the northern campaigns and fortified the border instead.

title.en: Toltecs occupy Chichen Itza

title.en: Capetian dynasty founded

summary.en: King Louis V of West Francia died without issue. Hugh Capet, Count of Paris, was elected king by an assembly of nobles, founding the Capetian dynasty. Initially, the Capetians controlled only a small territory around Paris, but the dynasty lasted more than three hundred years.

statement.zh: 西法兰克国王路易五世去世无嗣。巴黎伯爵雨果·卡佩在贵族会议上被推选为国王，建立卡佩王朝。卡佩王朝初期仅控制巴黎周边狭小领地，但延续三百余年。
statement.en: In 987, King Louis V of West Francia died without issue.

title.en: Mahmud of Ghazni invades India

summary.en: Sultan Mahmud of Ghazni led an army to India, capturing Peshawar. He plundered the treasuries of Indian temples, destroyed Buddhist monasteries, and introduced Islam to northern India.

statement.zh:
伽色尼苏丹马哈茂德率军远征印度，攻占白沙瓦。他掠夺印度神庙金银，摧毁佛教寺院，将伊斯兰教传入印度北部。远征以骑兵突袭与攻城掠夺为主，寺庙财富成为军费来源；宗教破坏与政治征服同时发生。北印度的政治与宗教格局由此改变。

把「伽色尼马哈茂德入侵印度」放回公元987年的伽色尼，可以看到军事变化的一个具体切面。
statement.en: Ghaznavid Sultan Mahmud led an expedition to India and captured Peshawar.

title.en: King Sweyn I of Denmark ascends the throne

summary.en: King Harald Bluetooth of Denmark was overthrown in a coup by his son Sweyn I Forkbeard. Sweyn I continued to promote Christianity and prepared a major invasion of England.

statement.zh: 丹麦国王蓝牙哈拉尔德被其子斯文一世发动政变推翻。斯文一世（八字胡）继位后继续推行基督教，并准备大举入侵英格兰。父子之争既涉王位继承，也涉新旧信仰与贵族势力的消长；斯文以赎罪与征战巩固权威，向英格兰索取贡赋，为日后北海帝国的雏形奠定基础。丹麦由此更深地卷入西欧政治。
statement.en: King Harald Bluetooth of Denmark was overthrown in a coup by his son Sweyn Forkbeard.

title.en: Baptism of Kievan Rus'

summary.en: After his baptism at Chersonesus, Grand Prince Vladimir of Kiev returned to Kiev and ordered the entire populace to be baptized in the Dnieper River. He also built Orthodox churches throughout the country and hired Byzantine priests to preach. The Rus' thus entered the Christian world.

title.en: Emperor Taizong of Song establishes the "Fengzhuang Ku" to reserve military funds

summary.en: In preparation for a future northern campaign, Emperor Taizong set up the Fengzhuang Ku (Sealed Treasury), depositing budget surpluses there exclusively for the recovery of the Sixteen Prefectures. However, the treasury was never used during his reign.

statement.zh:
宋太宗为准备未来的北伐，设置“封桩库”，将财政结余存入其中，专供收复燕云十六州之用。但直至太宗去世也未动用。封桩库把日常结余转为战略储备，体现以财政积累支撑军事目标的思路；专款专用也牵动户部与内库的权限。储备未及使用，反映北伐计划的迟疑。

把「宋太宗设置“封桩库”，储备军费」放回公元988年的北宋，可以看到经济变化的一个具体切面。

title.en: King Olof Skötkonung of Sweden converts to Christianity

summary.en: King Olof Skötkonung of Sweden was baptized at Uppsala, becoming the first Christian king of Sweden. Christianity spread further in Scandinavia.

statement.zh:
瑞典国王奥洛夫·舍特康努格在乌普萨拉接受洗礼，成为第一位信奉基督教的瑞典国王。基督教在斯堪的纳维亚进一步传播。皈依与王权整合相互配合，教会组织借王室支持建立主教区；旧信仰在民间延续，改宗是渐进过程。北欧由此进入基督教世界。

把「瑞典国王奥洛夫·舍特康努格皈依基督教」放回公元988年的瑞典，可以看到宗教变化的一个具体切面。

title.en: Fujiwara no Michinaga is born in Japan

summary.en: In 989 CE (Eien 3), Fujiwara no Michinaga was born. He became the most powerful politician of the Heian period, the architect of the Fujiwara regency's golden age. title.en: Byzantine Basil II establishes military districts (themata)

summary.en: Byzantine Emperor Basil II reformed the thema system, confiscating the estates of large landowners in Asia Minor and distributing them to soldiers in service. This strengthened the Byzantine military.

statement.zh:
拜占庭皇帝巴西尔二世改革军区制度，将小亚细亚的大贵族领地收归国有，分配给服役的士兵。这增强了拜占庭的军事实力。改革以兵役与土地挂钩，抑制豪强兼并，充实边防骑兵与步兵；贵族的反抗与皇权的强硬并行。军区制由此成为帝国的支柱。

把「拜占庭巴西尔二世设立军区」放回公元989年的拜占庭帝国，可以看到军事变化的一个具体切面。

title.en: Song-Liao conflict escalates: Battle of Yizhou

summary.en: A large Liao army advanced south and besieged Yizhou (present-day Yi County, Hebei). The Song general Yuan Jizhong defended the city; the Liao army failed to take it. After receiving reinforcements, Empress Dowager Xiao Chuo captured Yizhou, and the Song army withdrew to Mancheng.

statement.zh:
辽军大举南下，包围易州（今河北易县）。宋将袁继忠率军坚守，辽军攻城未克。萧太后增兵后，易州陷落，宋军退守满城。守城以城墙、壕堑与弓弩相持，援军不继；辽方以骑军迂回与增援破局。河北的防线被迫后移，边民纷纷南迁。

title.en: Emperor Taizong of Song issues an edict seeking frank advice

summary.en: Due to frequent natural disasters, Emperor Taizong issued an edict seeking frank advice, encouraging officials and commoners to write letters criticizing government policies. The official Wang Yucheng submitted a memorial, "Duangong Admonition," which criticized problems in the administration, and the emperor accepted it.

title.en: Oghuz Yabgu State, precursor to Kazakh Khanate, takes shape

summary.en: Around 990 CE, the Oghuz Turks on the Central Asian steppe established the Yabgu State. The Oghuz Yabgu State was a predecessor of the Kazakh Khanate, controlling trade routes across the steppe. The Oghuz began converting to Islam in the late 10th century.

title.en: Li Jiqian is enfeoffed as King of Xia by the Liao

summary.en: Emperor Shengzong of Liao formally invested Li Jiqian as "King of Xia" and bestowed upon him Khitan armor and horses. With Liao backing, Li Jiqian consolidated his position in Xiazhou and constantly raided the Song's northwestern border.

statement.zh:
辽圣宗正式册封李继迁为“夏国王”，并赐予契丹马甲。李继迁借助辽朝势力，在夏州站稳脚跟，不断侵扰北宋西北边境。册封把党项地方势力纳入辽的宗藩体系，辽以名号与物资换取侧翼牵制；李继迁则借外力巩固部落联盟。宋、辽、夏的三方关系由此复杂化。

把「李继迁被辽封为夏国王」放回公元990年的西夏，可以看到外交变化的一个具体切面。

title.en: Kievan Rus' and Byzantium form a marriage alliance

title.en: Toltec capital of Tula flourishes

summary.en: Tula, the capital of the Toltecs (in present-day Hidalgo State, Mexico), reached its zenith. The city featured warrior statues, pyramids, and ballcourts; Toltec culture influenced the later Aztec civilization.

statement.zh: 托尔特克人的首都图拉（今墨西哥伊达尔戈州）达到鼎盛。城中建有武士雕像、金字塔和球场，托尔特克文化影响了后来的阿兹特克文明。城市以祭祀中心与球场组织公共生活，武士形象体现军事与宗教的结合；贸易与移民把文化传向中部高原。中美洲的文明传统由此延续。

title.en: Irish king Brian Boru unites Ireland

summary.en: Brian Boru defeated the Dublin Vikings and united all of Ireland. He styled himself "Emperor of the Irish" and is considered one of Ireland's greatest monarchs.

statement.zh: 布莱恩·博鲁击败都柏林的维京人，统一爱尔兰全境。他自称“爱尔兰皇帝”，成为爱尔兰历史上最杰出的君主之一。统一依托地方王国的归附与对维京港口的控制，王权与教会、部族首领之间的联盟构成统治基础；称帝既是政治宣示，也反映爱尔兰诸王传统的整合。此后爱尔兰的政治中心一度稳固。
statement.en: Brian Boru defeated the Dublin Vikings and united all of Ireland.

title.en: Feudal structure of the Holy Roman Empire solidifies

summary.en: After Otto III came to power, he further strengthened the hierarchical feudal structure of the empire: ducal territories became hereditary, while the emperor's direct domain shrank. The empire gradually moved toward a loose federation.

statement.zh:
奥托三世亲政后，进一步强化帝国内的封建层级，诸侯领地世袭化，皇帝直辖领地缩水。帝国逐渐走向松散联邦。他倚重教会与地方贵族治理，以封赏换取忠诚，世袭与分封使中央的直接控制减弱；皇权在名义上仍居顶端，实际依赖诸侯合作。

把「神圣罗马帝国封建制巩固」放回公元991年的神圣罗马帝国，可以看到政治变化的一个具体切面。

title.en: Bolesław I becomes Duke of Poland

title.en: Wang Xiaobo and Li Shun revolt breaks out

summary.en: A peasant by the name of Wang Xiaobo in Qingcheng County, Sichuan, launched a rebellion with the slogan "equalize the rich and poor." He captured Qingcheng and Pengshan, and his army quickly swelled to tens of thousands. After Wang was killed in battle, Li Shun took over, captured Chengdu, and established the Great Shu regime.

statement.zh: 北宋四川青城县农民王小波因贫富不均，提出“均贫富”口号，发动起义。他攻占青城、彭山，队伍迅速壮大至数万人。王小波战死后，李顺继领起义军，攻占成都，建立大蜀政权。
statement.en:
A peasant by the name of Wang Xiaobo in Qingcheng County, Sichuan, launched a rebellion with the slogan "equalize the rich and poor." He captured Qingcheng and Pengshan, and his army quickly swelled to 10,000. After Wang was killed in battle, Li Shun took over, captured Chengdu, and established the Great Shu regime.

For Asia in 993 CE, “Wang Xiaobo and Li Shun revolt breaks out” is a traceable node of Military change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.en: Chola Empire invades Sri Lanka

summary.en: The South Indian Chola king Rajaraja I dispatched a powerful navy across the Palk Strait to capture Anuradhapura in northern Sri Lanka. The Chola Empire made northern Ceylon a province, ruling for about half a century.

statement.zh: 南印度朱罗国王罗阇罗阇一世派遣强大海军，横渡保克海峡，攻占斯里兰卡北部阿努拉德普勒。朱罗帝国将锡兰北部变为一个省，统治约半个世纪。
statement.en: The Chola king of South India, Rajaraja I, sent a powerful navy across the Palk Strait to capture Anuradhapura in northern Sri Lanka.

title.en: The first Khitan invasion of Goryeo; Seo Hui wins the Six Garrison Settlements

summary.en: Emperor Shengzong of Liao, citing Goryeo's allegiance to the Song calendar and its occupation of former Goguryeo territory, sent Xiao Hengde (Xiao Sunning), governor of the Eastern Capital, against the peninsula with a large army, which took Bongsan commandery. The Goryeo court was in uproar, some urging surrender and others the cession of everything north of the Western Capita

statement.en: Emperor Shengzong of Liao, citing Goryeo's allegiance to the Song calendar and its occupation of former Goguryeo territory, sent Xiao Hengde (Xiao Sunning), governor of the Eastern Capital, against the peninsula with a large army, which took Bongsan commandery.

en: Emperor Shengzong of Liao, citing Goryeo's allegiance to the Song calendar and its occupation of former Goguryeo territory, sent Xiao Hengde (Xiao Sunning), governor of the Eastern Capital, against the peninsula with a large army, which took Bongsan commandery.

statement.zh: 高丽自此奉辽正朔、断与宋朝的朝贡，并于其后数年筑兴化、龙州、通州等江东六州城堡，尽有清川江至鸭绿江之间的土地——不战而拓地数百里，为高丽外交史上的经典一役。
statement.en: Emperor Shengzong of Liao, citing Goryeo's allegiance to the Song calendar and its occupation of former Goguryeo territory, sent Xiao Hengde (Xiao Sunning), governor of the Eastern Capital, against the peninsula with a large army, which took Bongsan commandery.

zh: 高丽自此奉辽正朔、断与宋朝的朝贡，并于其后数年筑兴化、龙州、通州等江东六州城堡，尽有清川江至鸭绿江之间的土地——不战而拓地数百里，为高丽外交史上的经典一役。
en: Emperor Shengzong of Liao, citing Goryeo's allegiance to the Song calendar and its occupation of former Goguryeo territory, sent Xiao Hengde (Xiao Sunning), governor of the Eastern Capital, against the peninsula with a large army, which took Bongsan commandery.

statement.zh: 辽圣宗以高丽奉宋正朔、又侵据高句丽故地为由，遣东京留守萧恒德（萧逊宁）率大军压境，破蓬山郡。
statement.en: The Goryeo court was in uproar, some urging surrender and others the cession of everything north of the Western Capital.

zh: 辽圣宗以高丽奉宋正朔、又侵据高句丽故地为由，遣东京留守萧恒德（萧逊宁）率大军压境，破蓬山郡。
en: The Goryeo court was in uproar, some urging surrender and others the cession of everything north of the Western Capital.

statement.zh: 辽圣宗以高丽奉宋正朔、又侵据高句丽故地为由，遣东京留守萧恒德（萧逊宁）率大军压境，破蓬山郡。
statement.en: Until the general Seo Hui overrode them and went in person to the Khitan camp to argue: Goryeo was the successor of Goguryeo, hence its name and its capital at Pyongyang, and by that reckoning even the Liao Eastern Capital belonged to Goryeo; if it had sent no embassy to Liao, that was because the Jurchen blocked the roads.

zh: 辽圣宗以高丽奉宋正朔、又侵据高句丽故地为由，遣东京留守萧恒德（萧逊宁）率大军压境，破蓬山郡。
en: Until the general Seo Hui overrode them and went in person to the Khitan camp to argue: Goryeo was the successor of Goguryeo, hence its name and its capital at Pyongyang, and by that reckoning even the Liao Eastern Capital belonged to Goryeo; if it had sent no embassy to Liao, that was because the Jurchen blocked the roads.

statement.zh: 辽圣宗以高丽奉宋正朔、又侵据高句丽故地为由，遣东京留守萧恒德（萧逊宁）率大军压境，破蓬山郡。
statement.en: Xiao Hengde had no answer, withdrew, and conceded to Goryeo the Jurchen lands east of the Yalu.

zh: 辽圣宗以高丽奉宋正朔、又侵据高句丽故地为由，遣东京留守萧恒德（萧逊宁）率大军压境，破蓬山郡。
en: Xiao Hengde had no answer, withdrew, and conceded to Goryeo the Jurchen lands east of the Yalu.

statement.zh: 辽圣宗以高丽奉宋正朔、又侵据高句丽故地为由，遣东京留守萧恒德（萧逊宁）率大军压境，破蓬山郡。
statement.en: Goryeo thereafter adopted the Liao calendar and broke off tribute to Song, and over the next few years fortified Heunghwa, Yongju, Tongju and the other Six Garrison Settlements, taking possession of everything between the Cheongcheon and the Yalu — hundreds of li gained without a battle, and a classic of Korean diplomatic history.

title.en: Byzantine educational revival

summary.en: Byzantine Emperor Basil II promoted education, restoring the University of Constantinople and hiring distinguished scholars to teach philosophy, rhetoric, and mathematics. Classical Greek works were systematically organized and commented upon.

statement.zh:
拜占庭皇帝巴西尔二世重视教育，重修君士坦丁堡大学，聘请名师讲授哲学、修辞学和数学。古希腊经典著作被系统整理和注释。复兴以宫廷资助与学者网络为依托，抄本整理保存了古代知识；教育把古典学术与帝国治理相连。拜占庭的文化传承由此延续。

把「拜占庭帝国教育复兴」放回公元993年的拜占庭帝国，可以看到文化变化的一个具体切面。
statement.en: Byzantine Emperor Basil II valued education, rebuilt the University of Constantinople, and hired famous teachers to teach philosophy, rhetoric, and mathematics.

title.en: The Pillow Book (Makura no Sōshi) is written in Japan

summary.en: Around 993 CE (Shōryaku 4), Sei Shōnagon began writing her essay collection Makura no Sōshi (The Pillow Book). Sei Shōnagon was a female author of the Heian period who served as a lady-in-waiting to Empress Teishi (Sadako), consort of Emperor Ichijō. The Pillow Book recorded in exquisite detail various aspects of court life.

statement.zh: 日本正历4年（公元993年）左右，清少纳言开始创作随笔集《枕草子》。清少纳言是平安时代的女作家，曾在一条天皇的中宫定子身边担任女官。《枕草子》以细腻的笔触记录了宫中生活的方方面面。

title.en: Otto III is crowned Holy Roman Emperor

summary.en: Otto III, at age sixteen, was crowned Holy Roman Emperor by Pope Gregory V in Rome. He aimed to revive the ancient Roman Empire, making Rome his capital.

statement.zh:
奥托三世年满十六岁，在罗马由教皇格里高利五世加冕为神圣罗马帝国皇帝。他立志复兴古罗马帝国，定都罗马。加冕之后，他任用意大利与德意志的教士，尝试以帝国与教会的合作重建秩序；其早逝使计划中断。

把「奥托三世加冕为神圣罗马帝国皇帝」放回公元994年的神圣罗马帝国，可以看到政治变化的一个具体切面。
statement.en: Otto III turned sixteen and was crowned Holy Roman Emperor in Rome by Pope Gregory V.

title.en: Bolesław I of Poland conquers Silesia

summary.en: Bolesław I the Brave led his army to conquer Silesia (upper Oder River region), expanding his territory to the Elbe. He subsequently came into conflict with the Holy Roman Empire.

statement.zh:
波兰大公波列斯瓦夫一世率军征服奥得河上游的西里西亚地区，将领土扩展至易北河。他随后与神圣罗马帝国发生冲突。征服把波兰的势力推向西部，河流与要道成为争夺焦点；与帝国的摩擦源于边界与臣属关系。年轻国家的扩张伴随长期对抗。

title.en: Olaf I becomes king of Norway and imposes Christianity

summary.en: In 995 Olaf I Tryggvason returned from England, seized the Norwegian throne and at once imposed Christianity by force. He ordered the destruction of statues of the Norse gods, built churches throughout the country and brought in English clergy; nobles and peasants who refused baptism were exiled or executed. Olaf also promoted Christianity in Iceland, the Faroes and Greenland.

title.en: Mahmud of Ghazni begins his plundering campaigns in northern India

summary.en: Having consolidated his rule in Afghanistan, Sultan Mahmud of Ghazni began systematic plundering of northern India. He led Turkic cavalry through the Khyber Pass, capturing cities such as Peshawar from Hindu kingdoms, seizing vast amounts of gold, silver, and slaves, and plundering Hindu temples. Mahmud's expeditions opened the way for Islam to enter northern India, but also de

title.en: Northern Song strengthens governance of Sichuan after Li Shun rebellion

The "equalize the rich and poor" policy of the rebels

statement.zh: 北宋朝廷派遣宦官王继恩率大军镇压李顺领导的大蜀政权，攻破成都。李顺在城破后下落不明（一说被杀）。朝廷随后对四川进行大规模军事清乡和善后处理，废除起义军推行的“均贫富”政策，但采纳部分建议，减轻了贫苦农民的赋税负担。这次起义虽然失败，但提出的“均贫富”口号对后世产生了深远影响。
statement.en:
The Song court dispatched the eunuch Wang Ji'en with a large army to Sichuan, where he stormed Chengdu and suppressed the Great Shu regime. Li Shun's whereabouts after the fall of the city are unknown (some say he was killed). The court then carried out extensive military mopping-up operations and relief measures in Sichuan. The "equalize the rich and poor" policy of the rebels was abandoned, but some of their suggestions were adopted, such as reducing tax burdens on poor peasants. Although the rebellion failed, its slogan deeply influenced later generations.

title.en: Seongjong of Goryeo dies; Mokjong ascends the throne

summary.en: King Seongjong of Goryeo died after sixteen years on the throne. Acting on Choe Seung-no's "Twenty-eight Points on Current Affairs", he had suppressed unorthodox cults and promoted Confucian learning, founded the Gukjagam national academy, established twelve provincial governorships staffed by centrally appointed officials, organised the central government into three department

statement.zh: 在位十六年的高丽成宗王治去世。成宗采崔承老《时务28条》之议，罢淫祀而兴儒学，设国子监、置十二牧遣官分治，仿唐制立三省六部、定中央官制，又置常平仓（993）以平粜赈饥、铸铁钱以通货，并在徐熙折冲樽俎之下不失尺土而拓江东六州。高丽的典章制度至此大备，故谥曰"成"。成宗无子，由景宗之子王诵继位，是为穆宗。穆宗在位十二年，朝政多为其母千秋太后与外戚金致阳所把持，1009年西北面都巡检使康兆举兵入宫，穆宗被弑，辽圣宗遂以"讨康兆之逆"为名发动第二次入侵。
statement.en: King Seongjong of Goryeo died after sixteen years on the throne. Acting on Choe Seung-no's "28 Points on Current Affairs", he had suppressed unorthodox cults and promoted Confucian learning, founded the Gukjagam national academy, established twelve provincial governorships staffed by centrally appointed officials, organised the central government into three departments and six ministries on the Tang model, created the Sangpyeongchang ever-normal granaries in 993 to stabilise grain prices and relieve famine, and issued iron coinage; and through Seo Hui's negotiation he had ceded no ground to the Khitan while gaining the Six Garrison Settlements. Goryeo's institutions were essentially complete, and he was given the posthumous name "Seong", the Accomplished. Having no son, he was succeeded by Gyeongjong's son Wang Song as King Mokjong, whose twelve-year reign was dominated by his mother, the Cheonchu Queen Dowager, and her favourite Kim Chi-yang. In 1009 the frontier commander Kang Jo marched on the palace and killed Mokjong, giving Emperor Shengzong of Liao the pretext of "punishing the regicide" for a second invasion.

en: King Seongjong of Goryeo died after sixteen years on the throne. Acting on Choe Seung-no's "28 Points on Current Affairs", he had suppressed unorthodox cults and promoted Confucian learning, founded the Gukjagam national academy, established twelve provincial governorships staffed by centrally appointed officials, organised the central government into three departments and six ministries on the Tang model, created the Sangpyeongchang ever-normal granaries in 993 to stabilise grain prices and relieve famine, and issued iron coinage; and through Seo Hui's negotiation he had ceded no ground to the Khitan while gaining the Six Garrison Settlements. Goryeo's institutions were essentially complete, and he was given the posthumous name "Seong", the Accomplished. Having no son, he was succeeded by Gyeongjong's son Wang Song as King Mokjong, whose twelve-year reign was dominated by his mother, the Cheonchu Queen Dowager, and her favourite Kim Chi-yang. In 1009 the frontier commander Kang Jo marched on the palace and killed Mokjong, giving Emperor Shengzong of Liao the pretext of "punishing the regicide" for a second invasion.

statement.zh: 宋太宗赵光义病逝于开封，享年58岁。其第三子赵恒继位，是为宋真宗。真宗即位后改元咸平，初期励精图治，任用贤臣，减轻赋税，史称“咸平之治”。
statement.en:
Emperor Taizong of Song died of illness in Kaifeng at the age of 58. His third son, Zhao Heng, succeeded him as Emperor Zhenzong. After his accession, Zhenzong changed the reign title to Xianping and initially worked hard to govern, employing virtuous ministers and reducing taxes. This period is known as the "Xianping Restoration," a rare time of peace and prosperity in the early Northern Song.

For Asia in 997 CE, “Emperor Taizong of Song dies; Emperor Zhenzong succeeds” is a traceable node of Politics change whose significance is best read through later events.

en: Emperor Taizong of Song died of illness in Kaifeng at the age of 58. His third son, Zhao Heng, succeeded him as Emperor Zhenzong. After his accession, Zhenzong changed the reign title to Xianping and initially worked hard to govern, employing virtuous ministers and reducing taxes. This period is known as the "Xianping Restoration," a rare time of peace and prosperity in the early Northern Song.

statement.zh: 高丽穆宗元年十二月，改定文武两班及军人田柴科，按十八科品级重新厘定授田授柴之额：第一科给田百结、柴七十结，以下递减至第十八科给田二十结；武班与军人所受较景宗初定之制略有增益。
statement.en: Military officials and soldiers gained slightly on Gyeongjong's original scale, while reserve officials holding rank without office were cut sharply.

title.en: Emperor Zhenzong changes reign title to Xianping, beginning the Xianping Restoration

summary.en: Emperor Zhenzong of Song changed the reign title to Xianping (meaning "universal peace"). In the early part of his reign, he was diligent in government affairs, frugal in his personal life, reduced taxes, and promoted production. statement.zh: 宋真宗赵恒宣布改元“咸平”（意为天下太平）。他在位初期勤于政事，生活节俭，减轻赋税，发展生产。他任用李沆、寇准等贤相，整顿吏治，史称“咸平之治”，是北宋前期难得的治世。
statement.en:
Emperor Zhenzong of Song changed the reign title to Xianping (meaning "universal peace"). In the early part of his reign, he was diligent in government affairs, frugal in his personal life, reduced taxes, and promoted production. He appointed virtuous chancellors such as Li Hang and Kou Zhun, and improved the efficiency of the bureaucracy. This period is known as the "Xianping Restoration," a rare era of good governance in the early Northern Song.

For Asia in 998 CE, “Emperor Zhenzong changes reign title to Xianping, beginning the Xianping Restoration” is a traceable node of Politics change whose significance is best read through later events.

en: Emperor Zhenzong of Song changed the reign title to Xianping (meaning "universal peace"). In the early part of his reign, he was diligent in government affairs, frugal in his personal life, reduced taxes, and promoted production. This period is known as the "Xianping Restoration," a rare era of good governance in the early Northern Song.

statement.en: Under Toltec influence, the city-state of Chichen Itza began construction of the Kukulcán Pyramid (El Castillo).

statement.zh: 该金字塔高约三十米，四面各有九十一级台阶，加上顶层平台共计三百六十五级，与太阳历天数吻合，体现了玛雅人杰出的天文和建筑成就。
statement.en: The pyramid stands about thirty meters high, with 91 steps on each of its four sides; including the top platform, the total number of steps is 365, matching the number of days in the solar year, demonstrating the Maya's outstanding achievements in astronomy and architecture.

title.en: Persian philosopher Ibn Sina (Avicenna) is born

title.en: Otto III campaigns in Italy

summary.en: Holy Roman Emperor Otto III launched a military campaign in Italy to suppress a rebellion of Roman nobles. He attempted to restore the territory of the Roman Empire and competed with the Byzantine Empire for control of southern Italy. title.en: Sei Shōnagon finishes The Pillow Book

summary.en: The Japanese court lady Sei Shonagon completed 'The Pillow Book' under Emperor Ichijo, its sharp observations of court seasons and life opening the Japanese essay (zuihitsu) tradition.

statement.zh:

title.en: Seljuk Turk Empire flourishes

summary.en: The Seljuk Turks rose in Central Asia and established a vast empire. The Seljuks were a branch of the Oghuz Turks; their leader Seljuk and his successors conquered most of Central Asia and eastern Persia. The Seljuks converted to Sunni Islam, and in 1055 they captured Baghdad, replacing the Buwayhids as the protectors of the Abbasid caliphs. The Seljuk Empire had a profound imp

title.en: Chichen Itza becomes a major power in Yucatán

summary.en: The Maya city-state of Chichen Itza rose to become the dominant political entity in the Yucatán Peninsula. The city blended indigenous Maya and Toltec cultural elements; its iconic structures—the Kukulcán Pyramid, the observatory (El Caracol), and the Temple of the Warriors—display a distinctive architectural style. statement.zh: 玛雅城邦奇琴伊察在尤卡坦半岛崛起为最强大的政治实体。该城融合了玛雅本土文化和托尔特克文化元素，其标志性建筑如库库尔坎金字塔、天文台和战士神庙展现了独特的建筑风格。奇琴伊察在后古典时期（约900-1200年）统治了尤卡坦半岛北部，是当时中美洲最繁华和强大的城邦之一。
statement.en:
The Maya city-state of Chichen Itza rose to become the dominant political entity in the Yucatán Peninsula. The city blended indigenous Maya and Toltec cultural elements; its iconic structures—the Kukulcán Pyramid, the observatory (El Caracol), and the Temple of the Warriors—display a distinctive architectural style. Chichen Itza ruled the northern Yucatán during the Postclassic period (c. 900–1200), becoming one of the most prosperous and powerful city-states in Mesoamerica.

title.en: Taputapuatea

title.en: Otto III's Roman imperial dream

summary.en: Holy Roman Emperor Otto III, who had been educated in the classical tradition and was deeply influenced by Byzantine culture and Roman antiquities, carried out a series of political and religious activities aimed at reviving the ancient Roman Empire. He moved his court to Rome, appointed his former teacher Sylvester II as pope, and attempted to create a universal Christian empi

statement.zh: 神圣罗马帝国皇帝奥托三世怀着复兴古罗马帝国的梦想进行了一系列政治和宗教活动。奥托三世受过良好教育，深受拜占庭文化和罗马古典传统的影响。他定都罗马，扶植自己的老师西尔维斯特二世为教皇，试图建立一个以罗马为中心的普世基督教帝国。但1002年奥托三世因疟疾在意大利病逝，年仅21岁，其帝国复兴计划随之破灭。
statement.en:
Holy Roman Emperor Otto III, who had been educated in the classical tradition and was deeply influenced by Byzantine culture and Roman antiquities, carried out a series of political and religious activities aimed at reviving the ancient Roman Empire. He moved his court to Rome, appointed his former teacher Sylvester II as pope, and attempted to create a universal Christian empire centered on Rome. However, Otto III died of malaria in Italy in 1002 at the age of only 21, and his imperial revival plan collapsed with him.

For Europe in 1000, “Otto III's Roman imperial dream” is a traceable node of Politics change whose significance is best read through later events.

zh: 神圣罗马帝国皇帝奥托三世怀着复兴古罗马帝国的梦想进行了一系列政治和宗教活动。奥托三世受过良好教育，深受拜占庭文化和罗马古典传统的影响。他定都罗马，扶植自己的老师西尔维斯特二世为教皇，试图建立一个以罗马为中心的普世基督教帝国。但1002年奥托三世因疟疾在意大利病逝，年仅21岁，其帝国复兴计划随之破灭。
神圣罗马帝国皇帝奥托三世怀着复兴古罗马帝国的梦想进行了一系列政治和宗教活动。

He moved his court to Rome, appointed his former teacher Sylvester II as pope, and attempted to create a universal Christian empire centered on Rome. However, Otto III died of malaria in Italy in 1002 at the age of only 21, and his imperial revival plan collapsed with him.

title.en: Chinese practitioners practise variolation

summary.en: From the Song period, Chinese physicians inoculated healthy people with material from smallpox scabs, pioneering variolation against smallpox before it spread to Eurasia.

statement.zh: 宋代以降，中国医者以天花患者痘痂接种健康人，开创人痘预防天花的先例，后传至欧亚。接种取痘痂或痘液，经鼻腔或皮肤引入，使人经历轻微感染而获得免疫；方法在民间与医家之间流传，并有不同的接种方式。这一实践在近代疫苗学出现之前提供了预防天花的有效手段，其思路后来经多种渠道传向其他地区。
statement.en: Since the Song Dynasty, Chinese doctors have used the scabs of smallpox patients to inoculate healthy people, setting a precedent for the prevention of smallpox from smallpox, which later spread to Europe and Asia.

title.en: Leif Erikson reaches North America

summary.en: The Norse Viking explorer Leif Erikson led a crew of about 35 from Greenland westward and reached the coast of North America in the area of Newfoundland (which he called Vinland). title.en: Hawaii settled

summary.en: Polynesian navigators crossed more than four thousand kilometres from the Marquesas or Tahiti to the Hawaiian islands in double-hulled canoes, steering by stars, swells and the flight of birds. They brought taro, breadfruit, pigs and chickens, laid out irrigated taro ponds, and built a society ordered by chiefs (ali'i) and the kapu system of prohibitions, developing hula and su

statement.zh:
波利尼西亚航海者驾双体独木舟，凭星象、洋流与鸟迹导航，自马克萨斯或塔希提群岛横渡逾四千公里抵达夏威夷群岛。他们带来芋头、面包果、猪与鸡，开辟灌溉芋田，建立以酋长（阿里伊）与禁忌（卡普）制度为核心的社会，并发展出草裙舞与冲浪。近年测年多将定居时间定在公元1000至1200年之间。

title.en: Swahili city-states flourish

summary.en: The Swahili city-states of East Africa (Kilwa, Mombasa, Zanzibar) were built of coral stone and teak, blending Islamic and Bantu civilisation and commanding the Indian Ocean trade.

statement.zh: 东非沿岸的斯瓦希里城邦（基尔瓦、蒙巴萨、桑给巴尔）以珊瑚石与柚木建城，融合伊斯兰与班图文明，控印度洋贸易。季风航线把非洲内陆的黄金、象牙与阿拉伯、印度的商品连接起来，港口城市以清真寺、市场与城墙组织空间；斯瓦希里语与伊斯兰法通行。海洋贸易塑造了独特的海岸文化。
statement.en: The Swahili city-states on the coast of East Africa (Kilwa, Mombasa, Zanzibar) built cities with coral stone and teak, integrated Islamic and Bantu civilizations, and controlled trade in the Indian Ocean.

title.en: Ancient Hawaiian chiefdom society forms

summary.en: Around 1000 CE, Polynesian voyagers established complex chiefdom societies in the Hawaiian Islands. Hawaiians developed large-scale terraced irrigation systems for taro cultivation, constructed fishponds, and built temple platforms (heiau). Society was strictly stratified into chiefs (aliʻi), priests (kahuna), and commoners. Oral traditions such as the creation chant Kumulipo p

statement.zh:
约公元1000年，波利尼西亚航海者在夏威夷群岛建立了复杂的酋邦社会。夏威夷人发展出大规模的梯田灌溉系统（用于种植芋头），建造了鱼塘和神庙（heiau）平台。社会分层严格，分为酋长（ali'i）、祭司（kahuna）和平民。口头传统（如"库穆利波"创世歌）传承了数百年的系谱和历史，18世纪末卡美哈梅哈一世首次统一了夏威夷群岛。

zh: 约公元1000年，波利尼西亚航海者在夏威夷群岛建立了复杂的酋邦社会。夏威夷人发展出大规模的梯田灌溉系统（用于种植芋头），建造了鱼塘和神庙（heiau）平台。社会分层严格，分为酋长（ali'i）、祭司（kahuna）和平民。口头传统（如"库穆利波"创世歌）传承了数百年的系谱和历史，18世纪末卡美哈梅哈一世首次统一了夏威夷群岛。
